questions.stem:
12. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius 10 cm and height 64 cm is fully filled with water. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 25 cm and height 60 cm is held vertically on a horizontal stand. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the depth of the water in the vessel.

(b) Now, \(\frac{37}{64}\) of the volume of water in the vessel is removed. A student claims that the final area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is less than half of the original area of the wet curved surface of the vessel. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(64\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器完全注滿水。一個底半徑 \(25\) cm、高 \(60\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置在水平架上。現將圓柱中的水倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 求圓錐容器中水的深度。

(b) 現移除圓錐容器中 \(\frac{37}{64}\) 的水。某學生聲稱圓錐容器最終的濕曲面面積少於原本濕曲面面積的一半。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 12. (a) The volume of the water \[=\pi(10)^{2}(64)\] \[=6400 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the water surface and \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of the water in the vessel. \[\frac{r}{25}=\frac{h}{60}\] \[r=\frac{5 h}{12}\] \[\therefore \frac{1}{3} \pi\left(\frac{5 h}{12}\right)^{2} h=6400 \pi\] \[h^{3}=110592\] \[ h=48 \] The depth of the water is 48 cm . (b) \[\frac{\text { Final volume of the water }}{\text { Original volume of the water }}\] \[=1-\frac{37}{64}\] \[=\frac{27}{64}\] \[\frac{\text { Final wet surface area }}{\text { Original wet surface area }}\] \[=\left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{64}}\right)^{2}\] \[=\frac{9}{16}>\frac{1}{2}\] ∴ Disagree f.t. (7 marks)

questions.stem:
14. \(X\) is a solid frustum which is made by cutting off the upper part of a solid right circular cone of base radius \(15\text{ cm}\) and height \(36\text{ cm}\). It is given that the curved surface area of \(X\) is \(325\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(Y\) is a vessel in the shape of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. The upper base radius of \(Y\) is \(24\text{ cm}\) and the lower base radius of \(Y\) is \(16\text{ cm}\). \(Y\) is similar to \(X\) in shape. \(Y\) contains \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water. \(X\) is put into \(Y\) and \(X\) is totally immersed in the water without overflowing. Someone claims that the depth of water in \(Y\) exceeds \(15\text{ cm}\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(X\) 為一個實心截頭錐，由切除一個底半徑 \(15\) cm、高 \(36\) cm 的實心直立圓錐的上部造成。已知 \(X\) 的曲面面積為 \(325\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) \(Y\) 為一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。\(Y\) 的上底半徑為 \(24\) cm，下底半徑為 \(16\) cm。\(Y\) 與 \(X\) 形狀相似。\(Y\) 盛有 \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水。將 \(X\) 放入 \(Y\) 中，\(X\) 完全浸入水中且沒有溢出。某人聲稱 \(Y\) 中水深超過 \(15\) cm。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+36^2}=39.\] Its curved surface area is \[\pi(15)(39)=585\pi.\] Hence the curved surface area of the cone cut off is \[585\pi-325\pi=260\pi.\] Let the radius of the cone cut off be \(r\). Since curved surface areas of similar cones are in the square of the linear ratio, \[\left(\frac{r}{15}\right)^2=\frac{260}{585}=\frac49.\] Thus \[ r=10. \] The height of the cone cut off is \[\frac{10}{15}\times 36=24.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)-\frac13\pi(10)^2(24) =2700\pi-800\pi =1900\pi.\] (b) Since \(Y\) is similar to \(X\), the linear scale factor from \(X\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{24}{15}=1.6.\] The smaller cone cut off from the larger inverted cone for \(Y\) has radius \(16\text{ cm}\), corresponding to radius \(10\text{ cm}\) in \(X\). Its height is \[24(1.6)=38.4\text{ cm}.\] The volume of this smaller cone is \[\frac13\pi(16)^2(38.4)=3276.8\pi.\] After \(X\) is immersed, the total volume below the water surface, measured from the apex of the smaller cone, is \[3276.8\pi+3500\pi+1900\pi=8676.8\pi.\] Let the water depth in \(Y\) be \(x\text{ cm}\). Then \[\left(\frac{x+38.4}{38.4}\right)^3=\frac{8676.8}{3276.8}.\] Hence \[x=38.4\sqrt[3]{\frac{8676.8}{3276.8}}-38.4 \approx 14.725.\] Since \[14.725<15,\] the claim is not correct.

The circular cone is then divided into a right circular cone \(X\), a small frustum \(Y\) and a large frustum \(Z\) by two planes parallel to its base. It is given that the base radius of the right circular cone \(X\) is 5 cm .

(a) Find the height and the volume of the right circular cone \(X\).

(b) (i) Find the curved surface area of the right circular cone \(X\).
(ii) Given that frustum \(Y\) is similar to frustum \(Z\), find the total surface area of the frustum \(Y\).
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐 \(W\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(80\) cm 及 \(192\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個小截頭錐 \(Y\) 及一個大截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知圓錐 \(X\) 的底半徑為 \(5\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的高及體積。

(b) 

(i) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 與截頭錐 \(Z\) 相似，求截頭錐 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \[\frac{h}{192} =\frac{5}{80} \\ h =12\] The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . The volume of right circular cone \(X=\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2}(12)\) \(=100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Alternative Solutions: The volume of right circular cone \(W=\frac{1}{3} \pi(80)^{2}(192)\) \(=409600 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{V}{409600 \pi} =\left(\frac{5}{80}\right)^{3} \\ V =100 \pi\) The volume of right circular cone \(X\) is \(100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2} h =100 \\ h =12\) The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . (b) (i) The slant height of circular cone \(X=\sqrt{12^{2}+5^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}=13 \mathrm{~cm}\) \[\text { The curved surface area } =\pi(5)(13) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =65 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(204 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\] (ii) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the lower base radius of frustum \(Y\). Then the upper base radius of frustum \(Z\) is also \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{5}{r}=\frac{r}{80}\) \(r=20\) or \(r=-20\) (reject) Let \(A \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) the curved surface area of the right of frustum \(Y\). \( \frac{65 \pi}{65 \pi+A}=\left(\frac{5}{20}\right)^{2} \\ \qquad A=975 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \therefore \text { The total surface area of the frustum } Y =\left[\pi(5)^{2}+\pi(20)^{2}+975 \pi\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =1400 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(4400 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\) (8 marks)

questions.stem:
13. There are two similar inverted right circular conical vessels. For the larger vessel, the base radius and the slant height are \(45\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the larger vessel to that of the smaller vessel is \(9:4\).

(a) Express the capacity of the smaller vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is now poured into the larger vessel. Then, four solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are put into the vessel and are totally immersed. The water that overflows is then collected by the smaller vessel.

(i) Express the volume of water overflowed in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the smaller vessel does not exceed \(670\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個相似的倒置直立圓錐形容器。較大容器的底半徑及斜高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(51\) cm。已知較大容器與較小容器的曲面面積比為 \(9:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示較小容器的容量。

(b) 現將 \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水倒入較大容器，再放入四個半徑 \(6\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。溢出的水由較小容器盛載。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求溢出的水體積。
(ii) 某人聲稱較小容器的濕曲面面積不超過 \(670\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the larger vessel is \[\sqrt{51^2-45^2}=24\text{ cm}.\] The capacity of the larger vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\] Since the ratio of curved surface areas is \(9:4\), the linear scale factor from the larger vessel to the smaller vessel is \(3:2\), and the volume scale factor is \(27:8\). Therefore, the capacity of the smaller vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right)^{3/2}=4800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The volume overflowed is \(15500\pi+4\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\) Thus the volume overflowed is \(452\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The area of the wet curved surface in the smaller vessel is \[\pi(45)(51)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right) \left(\frac{452\pi}{4800\pi}\right)^{2/3}.\] This is approximately \[663.2564917\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[663.2564917<670,\] the claim is agreed.

11. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 12 cm and height 9 cm contains water to a depth of 6 cm . All the water in the vessel is now poured into an empty right circular cylindrical cup without overflow and the depth of water is 12.8 cm .

(a) Find the base radius of the cylindrical cup. Leave your answer in surd form.

(b) A solid metal sphere with surface area equal to one-fifth of the curved surface area of the vessel is then put into the cylindrical cup. The metal sphere is completely immersed in water and no water spills out of the cup. Find the rise in water level in the cylindrical cup.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(9\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(6\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個空直立圓柱杯且沒有溢出，水深為 \(12.8\) cm。

(a) 求圓柱杯的底半徑，答案以根式表示。

(b) 再將一個實心金屬球放入圓柱杯，其表面積等於容器曲面面積的五分之一。球完全浸入水中且沒有水溢出。求圓柱杯水位的上升高度。
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution:
11.(a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the water surface in the vessel. \(\frac{r}{12} =\frac{6}{9} \\ r =8\) 
 Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the cylindrical cup. \(\pi R^{2} \times 12.8 =\frac{1}{3} \pi\left(8^{2}\right)(6) \\ R =\sqrt{10}\) 
 ∴ The base radius of the cylindrical cup is \(\sqrt{10} \mathrm{~cm}\). (b) Slant height of the curved surface in the vessel \(=\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}}=15 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Let \(s \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the sphere. \[\pi \times 12 \times 15=5 \times 4 \pi s^{2} \\ s=3 \\ \text { Rise in water level } =\frac{4}{3} \pi(3)^{3} \div \pi(\sqrt{10})^{2} \\ =3.6 \mathrm{~cm}\]

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some water. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of water in the vessel is \(12\text{ cm}\). \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is poured into the vessel. It is given that the depth of water in the vessel becomes \(18\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find the final volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at most \(1100\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些水，容器垂直放置。水深為 \(12\) cm。再倒入 \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水後，水深變為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中最終的水體積。

(b) 某人聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最多為 \(1100\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let the final volume of water be \(x\text{ cm}^3\). Since the depths before and after pouring are \(12\text{ cm}\) and \(18\text{ cm}\), the volume ratio is \[12^3:18^3=8:27.\] Thus \[\frac{x-950\pi}{x}=\frac{8}{27}.\] Hence \[27(x-950\pi)=8x.\] So \[19x=25650\pi,\] and \[x=1350\pi.\] Therefore, the final volume is \[1350\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the radius of the water surface after pouring. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(18)=1350\pi.\] Hence \[ r=15. \] The slant height of the wet cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+18^2}=\sqrt{549}.\] The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{549}\approx 1104.148\text{ cm}^2.\] Since this is greater than \(1100\text{ cm}^2\), I disagree with the claim.

questions.solution: 11. A bowl in the shape of a hemisphere has a radius of \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). An inverted right circular conical container with a base radius of 36 cm and a height of 48 cm is held vertically. The curved surface area of the container is 7.5 times that of the bowl. (a) Find \(r\). (b) Initially, there is some water in a container with a depth of \(h \mathrm{~cm}\). A hemispherical bowl is used to pour water into the container. After pouring \(5 \frac{1}{4}\) bowls of water into the container without overflowing, the depth of the water increases to \(4 h \mathrm{~cm}\). Find \(h\). (a) 求容器中水深。

questions.solution: 14. An inverted right circular cone is of base radius 120 cm and height 64 cm . A container in the form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of the inverted right circular cone. The height of the container is 48 cm . The container is placed with its smaller circular face on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the container. It is known that the area of the wet curved surface of the container is \(5355 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). (a) Find the depth of water in the container. (b) Someone claims that the volume of water in the container is less than \(0.2 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Curved surface area of the circular cone \[=\pi(120) \sqrt{120^{2}+64^{2}}\] \[=\pi(120)(136)\] \[=16320 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Height of the lower part \(=64-48=16 \mathrm{~cm}\) Curved surface area of the lower part \[=\left(\frac{16}{64}\right)^{2} \times 16320 \pi\] \[=1020 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of water. \[\left(\frac{h+16}{16}\right)^{2} =\frac{1020 \pi+5355 \pi}{1020 \pi} \\ (h+16)^{2} =1600 \\ h+16 =40 \text { or }-40 \text { (rejected) } \\ h =24\] ∴ The depth of water is 24 cm . (b) Volume of the circular cone \(=\frac{1}{3} \pi(120)^{2}(64)\) Volume of the lower part \(=\left(\frac{16}{64}\right)^{3} \times 307200 \pi\) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of water. \(\frac{V+4800 \pi}{4800 \pi} =\left(\frac{24+16}{16}\right)^{3} \\ V+4800 \pi =75000 \pi \\ V =70200 \pi\) Volume of water \(=70200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(=0.220539804 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\) \(>0.2 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. \(=307200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(=4800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 1 M for \(\pi r \ell\) 1 M for any correct ratio

questions.stem:
12. There are two hemispherical vessels held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessels are fully filled with water. The ratio of the wet surface area of the smaller hemispherical vessel to the wet surface area of the larger hemispherical vessel is \(16: 25\). The radius of the smaller hemispherical vessel is 10 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total volume of water in the two hemispherical vessels.

(b) Another vessel \(X\) is in the form of a frustum which is made by cutting off the upper part of a right circular cone. The radii of the upper base and the lower base of \(X\) are 10 cm and 15 cm respectively. \(X\) is placed on a horizontal ground. The water in the two hemispherical vessels is poured into \(X\). questions.stemZh:
12. 兩個半球形容器垂直放在水平面上，均完全注滿水。較小半球與較大半圓的濕表面面積比為 \(16:25\)，較小半球半徑為 \(10\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求兩個半球容器中總水體積。

(b) 另一個容器 \(X\) 為截頭錐，由切除一個直立圓錐的上部造成。\(X\) 的上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(15\) cm。將 \(X\) 放在水平地面，把兩個半球容器中的水倒入 \(X\)，水剛好注滿 \(X\)。求 \(X\) 的高。

questions.solution: 12. There are two hemispherical vessels held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessels are fully filled with water. The ratio of the wet surface area of the smaller hemispherical vessel to the wet surface area of the larger hemispherical vessel is \(16: 25\). The radius of the smaller hemispherical vessel is 10 cm . (a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total volume of water in the two hemispherical vessels. ( 3 marks) (b) Another vessel \(X\) is in the form of a frustum which is made by cutting off the upper part of a right circular cone. The radii of the upper base and the lower base of \(X\) are 10 cm and 15 cm respectively. \(X\) is placed on a horizontal ground. The water in the two hemispherical vessels is poured into \(X\). If the water can just fill up \(X\), find the height of \(X\). 12. (a) Let \(x \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger hemispherical vessel. \[\frac{16}{25}=\left(\frac{10}{x}\right)^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}\] Wet surface area of the smaller vessel \(=2 \pi(10)^{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}=200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Wet surface area of the larger vessel \[=\frac{25}{16} \times 200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}\] \[=312.5 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Let \(x \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger vessel. \[2 \pi x^{2}=312.5 \pi\] \[ x=12.5 \] \[\text { Total volume of water } =\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \pi\left(12.5^{3}+10^{3}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{3} 1 \mathrm{M} \text { for the volume of one hemisphere } \\ =\underline{\underline{1968.75 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}}} 1 \mathrm{~A}\] (b) Let \(H \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the heights of the upper part of the cone being cut off and the frustum respectively. \[\frac{H}{H+h}=\frac{10}{15} 1 \mathrm{M} \\ H=2 h \\ \frac{1}{3} \pi(15)^{2}(H+h)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(10)^{2} H=1968.75 \pi 1 \mathrm{M} \text { for the volume of frustum } \\ 225(3 h)-100(2 h)=5906.25 \\ 475 h=5906.25 \\ h \approx 12.43421053 \] ∴ The height of the frustum is \(\underline{12.4 \mathrm{~cm}}\) (corr. to 3 sig. fig.).

questions.stem:
14. The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(20\) cm. The height of the pyramid is \(18\) cm.

(a) The pyramid is inverted and divided into a frustum and a smaller pyramid by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of the frustum is \(9\) cm. Find the volume of the frustum.

(b) A container consists of two parts with a common base. The upper part is the frustum described in (a) and the lower part is a cuboid of height \(8\) cm. Water is poured into the container to a depth of \(11\) cm. Find the volume of the water in the container.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(20\) cm 的正方形，高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 將錐體倒置，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐及一個小錐體。已知截頭錐高 \(9\) cm，求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 一個容器由兩部分組成，共享同一底面。上部為 

(a) 所述的截頭錐，下部為高 \(8\) cm 的長方體。將水倒入容器至深度 \(11\) cm，求容器中水的體積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(20)^2(18)=2400\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[18-9=9\text{ cm}.\] The ratio of the heights of the smaller pyramid and the original pyramid is \[9:18=1:2.\] Therefore, the ratio of their volumes is \[1^3:2^3=1:8.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac{1}{8}(2400)=300\text{ cm}^3.\] Hence the volume of the frustum is \[2400-300=2100\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The lower cuboid has square base of side \(10\) cm, so the volume of water in the cuboid is \[10^2(8)=800\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the water depth is \(11\) cm, the height of water in the frustum is \[11-8=3\text{ cm}.\] The corresponding similar pyramids have heights \(12\) cm and \(9\) cm, so their height ratio is \[12:9=4:3.\] The volume of the pyramid of height \(9\) cm is \(300\text{ cm}^3\). Thus the volume of the pyramid of height \(12\) cm is \[300\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3=\frac{6400}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of water in the frustum part is \[\frac{6400}{9}-300=\frac{3700}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] The total volume of water is \[800+\frac{3700}{9} =\frac{10900}{9} \approx 1210\text{ cm}^3\] correct to 3 significant figures.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）原角錐 = 2400。小角錐高 9，比 1:2，體積比 1:8，小角錐 = 300，截頭錐 = 2100 cm³。
（b）下方長方體底邊 10，水 = 800，水深 8，總深 11 cm。

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel is held vertically and fully filled with soft drink. The depth of soft drink in the vessel is 18 cm . Patrick drinks \(364 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) of soft drink and now he finds that the depth of soft drink in the vessel is 15 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of remaining soft drink in the vessel.
( 3 marks )

(b) Patrick then pours the remaining soft drink into a right cylindrical vessel without overflowing. The base radius of the cylindrical vessel is 5 cm . Patrick claims that the total area of the wet surface of the cylindrical vessel is greater than \(700 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置，完全注滿汽水。汽水深度為 \(18\) cm。Patrick 喝了 \(364\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 汽水後，發現汽水深度變為 \(15\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中餘下的汽水體積。（3 分）

(b) Patrick 將餘下的汽水倒入一個直立圓柱形容器且沒有溢出，圓柱底半徑為 \(5\) cm。Patrick 聲稱圓柱容器的濕表面總面積大於 \(700\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Calculate the values, then compare with the claim. State agree/disagree clearly.
questions.hintZh: 先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of remaining soft drink. By the property of similar solids, we have \[\frac{V+364 \pi}{V}=\left(\frac{18}{15}\right)^{3} \\ 125 V+45500 \pi=216 V \\ V=500 \pi\] \(\therefore \) Volume of remaining soft drink \(=500 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (b) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of soft drink in the cylindrical vessel. \[500 \pi=\pi(5)^{2} h \\ h=20\] Total area of the wet surface \(=\left(\pi(5)^{2}+2 \pi(5)(20)\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=225 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(\approx 706.858 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(> 700 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) The claim is agreed.

(a) 求立體 \(A\) 的油漆成本。

(b) 立體 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 為相似立體，\(A\) 的油漆成本比 \(B\) 高 \(40\%\)。Mary 聲稱立體 \(B\) 的體積最少為 \(580\text{ cm}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: 13. The painting cost (in $) of a solid is a sum of two parts, one part is constant and the other part varies as the surface area (in \(\mathrm{cm}^{2}\) ) of the solid. The painting cost for a solid with surface area \(200 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 300\) while the painting cost for a solid with surface area \(250 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 360\). Suppose the surface area of solid \(A\) is \(720 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and the volume of Solid \(A\) is \(1000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (a) Find the painting cost of \(\operatorname{solid} A\). (b) Solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar solids. The painting cost of solid \(A\) is at \(40 \%\) higher than that of solid \(B\). Mary claims that the volume of solid \(B\) is at least \(580 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks) (a) Let \(\$ C\) be the painting cost of a solid and \(S \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be its surface area. Let \(C=k_{1}+k_{2} S\), where \(k_{1}\) and \(k_{2}\) are non-zero constants. So, we have \(300=k_{1}+k_{2}(200)\) and \(360=k_{1}+k_{2}(250)\). 1 M either Solving, we have \(k_{1}=60\) and \(k_{2}=1.2\). both correct Painting cost of solid \(A\) \[=\$[60+1.2(720)]\] \[=\underline{\underline{\$ 924}}\] (b) Let \(V_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) and \(V_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volumes of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively, and let \(S_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and \(S_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be the surface area of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. The painting cost of the Solid \(B=\$ 924 \div(1+40 \%)\) \(=\underline{\underline{\$ 660}}\) \(660=60+1.2 S_{B}\) \(S_{B}=500\) Note that solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. \(\frac{V_{A}}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{S_{A}}{S_{B}}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(\frac{1000}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{720}{500}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(V_{B} \approx 578.7037037<580\) Thus, the claim is incorrect. f.t. ----(4)

It is given that the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 8 times to the curved surface area of \(X\) and the volume of \(Y\) is greater than the volume of \(X\) by \(8000 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\).

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(4 marks)

(b) Suppose the height of \(X\) is 15 cm . Mr. Cheung claims that the total surface area of cone \(W\) is greater than the surface area of a sphere with radius 21 cm . Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐 \(W\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成兩部分：上部為小圓錐 \(X\)，下部為截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(8\) 倍，且 \(Y\) 的體積比 \(X\) 多 \(8000\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。（4 分）

(b) 設 \(X\) 的高為 \(15\) cm。Mr. Cheung 聲稱圓錐 \(W\) 的總表面積大於一個半徑 \(21\) cm 的球的表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
14.(a) Let \(V_{X} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) and \(V_{Y} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volumes of \(X\) and \(Y\) respectively. 
 Let \(h_{X} \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(h_{Y} \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(X\) and \(Y\) respectively. 
 \(\frac{h_{X}}{h_{X}+h_{Y}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{1+8}}=\frac{1}{3}\) {*}{\(\left\{1 \mathrm{M} \\ +1 \mathrm{~A}\right.\)} 
 \(\frac{V_{X}}{V_{X}+V_{Y}}=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{3}=\frac{1}{27}\) 
 \(\frac{V_{X}}{V_{X}+V_{X}+8000 \pi}=\frac{1}{27}\) 1 M 
 \(25 V_{X}=8000 \pi\) 
 \(V_{X}=320 \pi\) 
 ∴ The volume of \(X\) is \(320 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 
 (b) Volume of \(W\) 
 \(=320 \pi \times 27=8640 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Height of \(W\) 
 \(=15 \times 3=45 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(W\) 
 \(\frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2} \times 45=8640 \pi\) for volume of cone 
 \(r=24\) 
 Alternate Method: 
 Let \(r_{w}\) be the base radius of \(X\) 
 \(\frac{1}{3} \pi r_{w}{ }^{2} \times 15=320 \pi\) 1 M for volume of cone 
 \(r_{w}=8\) 
 \(r=3 \times 8=24\) 
 Total surface area of \(W\) 
 \(=\pi \times 24 \times \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}+\pi \times 24^{2}\) for \(\pi r l\) 
 \(=1800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 Surface area of sphere 
 \(=4 \pi \times 21^{2}\) 1 M for \(4 \pi r^{2}\) 
 \(=1764 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 \(<1800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 The total surface area of \(W\) is greater than the surface area of sphere. 
 The claim is agreed. 1f.t. 
 -------(9)

questions.stem: 14. A right circular cone is cut into three parts by two planes parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of the upper part of the cone are 6 cm and 20 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the upper part of the cone in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks) (b) If the height of the middle part is 10 cm, find the volume of the middle part. (3 marks) (c) The height of the lower part is 10 cm. Amy claims that the curved surface area of the lower part is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分。圓錐上部的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(20\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐上部的體積。（2 分）

(b) 若中間部分的高為 \(10\) cm，求中間部分的體積。（3 分）

(c) 下部的高為 \(10\) cm。Amy 聲稱下部的曲面面積多於 \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the upper cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(20)=240\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (2 marks) (b) Since the planes are parallel to the base, the cones are similar. The upper cone has height 20 cm and radius 6 cm. For the cone formed by the upper and middle parts, its height is \[20+10=30\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its radius is \[6\cdot\frac{30}{20}=9\text{ cm}.\] Hence the volume of the cone formed by the upper and middle parts is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)^2(30)=810\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle part is \[810\pi-240\pi=570\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (c) The whole cone has height \[20+10+10=40\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its base radius is \[6\cdot\frac{40}{20}=12\text{ cm}.\] The radius at the top of the lower part is \(9\) cm, and the radius at the bottom of the lower part is \(12\) cm. The height of the lower part is \(10\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+(12-9)^2}=\sqrt{109}\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the lower frustum is \[\pi(9+12)\sqrt{109}=21\sqrt{109}\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[21\sqrt{109}>200,\] the curved surface area is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Therefore, I agree with Amy's claim. (4 marks)

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 20 cm and 48 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a cone \(X\), a middle frustum \(Y\) and a bottom frustum \(Z\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the height of \(Z\) is 12 cm.

(a) Express the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Another different solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a cone \(T\) by a plane parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is 16 cm. The total surface area of \(S\) is equal to the sum of the total surface areas of \(Y\) and \(Z\). Is \(Z\) similar to \(S\)? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個中截頭 \(Y\) 及一個下截頭 \(Z\)。已知 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 相似，且 \(Z\) 的高為 \(12\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的總表面積之和。\(Z\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) For the bottom frustum \(Z\), the lower radius is 20 cm and the height is 12 cm. Its upper plane is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex of the original cone. By similarity of cones, the upper radius of \(Z\) is \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}.\] The volume of \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] The total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the lower radius of \(Y\) is the upper radius of \(Z\), the linear scale factor from \(Z\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{15}{20}=\frac34.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(Y\) is \[1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }Z} =\frac{1687.5\pi}{1080\pi} =\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }Z}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =\frac{16}{9}.\] Since \[\frac{25}{16}\ne\frac{16}{9},\] \(Z\) and \(S\) are not similar. (4 marks)

14. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius 12 cm and height 16 cm and an inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 30 cm and height 15 cm are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(16\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器，與一個底半徑 \(30\) cm、高 \(15\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器，均垂直放置。圓柱容器完全注滿水，現將水倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器中水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 求圓錐容器中水深。（4 分）

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(4\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器，球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of water is equal to the volume of the cylinder: \[\pi(12)^2(16)=2304\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the depth of water in the conical vessel be \(h\) cm. By similarity, the radius of the water surface is \[\frac{30}{15}h=2h.\] Thus \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(2h)^2h=2304\pi.\) So \(\frac{4}{3}h^3=2304,\) and hence \(h^3=1728.\) Therefore \(h=12.\) The depth of water is 12 cm. (c) The remaining volume of the conical vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(30)^2(15)-2304\pi=2196\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The volume of the sphere is \(\frac{4}{3}\pi(4)^3=\frac{256}{3}\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Since \(\frac{256}{3}\pi<2196\pi,\) the water will not overflow. (9 marks)

(a) 求容器中水深。

(b) 已知 \(195\) 個半徑 \(12\) cm 的半球形容器完全注滿水，現將全部水倒入圓錐容器且沒有溢出。某人聲稱圓錐容器的濕曲面面積增加最少為 \(30000\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

13. A vessel in form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. The radii of the upper base and the lower base are 16 cm and 4 cm respectively. The height of the frustum is 36 cm.

(a) Find the capacity of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) The vessel contains \(10000\text{ cm}^3\) of water. Now, Sam puts n solid metal spheres of radii 3 cm into the vessel and the spheres are totally immersed in the water.

(i) Find the maximum value of n such that the water in the vessel will not overflow.
(ii) Sam claims that the wetted curved surface area of the vessel now is less than \(2350\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(16\) cm 及 \(4\) cm，截頭錐高 \(36\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的容量。（2 分）

(b) 容器中有 \(10000\text{ cm}^3\) 水。Sam 放入 \(n\) 個半徑 \(3\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。

(i) 求 \(n\) 的最大值，使容器中的水不會溢出。
(ii) Sam 聲稱容器現時的濕曲面面積少於 \(2350\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) Let h cm be the height of the removed circular cone. \[\frac{4}{h}=\frac{16}{h+36},\) so \(h=12.\] The height of the original cone is \(48\) cm. The capacity of the vessel is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(16)^2(48)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(4)^2(12) =4032\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(2) (b) (i) The volume of each sphere is \[\frac{4}{3}\pi(3)^3=36\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] For no overflow, \(10000+36\pi n\le 4032\pi.\) \[n\le \frac{4032\pi-10000}{36\pi}\approx 23.58.\] Therefore, the maximum value of n is 23. (ii) The capacity of the removed cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(4)^2(12)=64\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The curved surface area of the removed cone is \(\pi(4)\sqrt{4^2+12^2}=16\pi\sqrt{10}.\) Let A \(\text{cm}^2\) be the wetted curved surface area of the vessel after putting 23 spheres into it. By similarity, \(\frac{A+16\pi\sqrt{10}}{16\pi\sqrt{10}} =\left(\frac{10000+23(36\pi)+64\pi}{64\pi}\right)^{2/3}.\) Hence \(A\approx 2375.641967>2350.\) Therefore, the wetted curved surface area of the vessel now is not less than \(2350\text{ cm}^2\). I do not agree with Sam. ------------------(5)

questions.stem:
12. A solid metal right prism of base area \(84\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(20\) cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids. The bases of the two pyramids are squares. The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(4:9\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger pyramid.

(b) If the height of the larger pyramid is \(12\) cm, find the total surface area of the smaller pyramid.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底面積 \(84\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(20\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(4:9\)。

(a) 求較大錐的體積。

(b) 若較大錐的高為 \(12\) cm，求較小錐的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The total volume of metal is \(84(20)=1680\text{ cm}^3.\) The ratio of corresponding lengths of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(\sqrt{4:9}=2:3.\) Hence the ratio of their volumes is \(8:27.\) (a) The volume of the larger pyramid is \[1680\left(\frac{27}{8+27}\right)=1296\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[1680-1296=384\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac23(12)=8\text{ cm}.\] Let the side length of its square base be \(s\). Then \[\frac13s^2(8)=384\] so \[s^2=144,\qquad s=12.\] The slant height of each triangular face is \[\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10.\] Thus the total surface area is \[144+4\left(\frac12(12)(10)\right)=384\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(1296\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(384\text{ cm}^2\).

9. The sum of the volumes of two spheres is \(324\pi\text{ cm}^3\). The radius of the larger sphere is equal to the diameter of the smaller sphere. Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of the larger sphere;

(b) the sum of the surface areas of the two spheres.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 兩個球的體積和為 \(324\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。較大球的半徑等於較小球的直徑。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 較大球的體積；

(b) 兩個球的表面積之和。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.solution: The ratio of the radii of the larger sphere to the smaller sphere is \(2:1\), so the ratio of their volumes is \(8:1\). (a) \[\text{Volume of larger sphere}=\frac8{9}(324\pi)=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(R\). Then \[\frac43\pi R^3=288\pi\] so \[ R=6. \] The smaller radius is \(3\) cm. (b) \[4\pi(6^2)+4\pi(3^2)=180\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(288\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(180\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh:
半徑比 2:1，體積比 8:1。
（a）大球 = 288π。(4/3)πR³ = 288π，R = 6。小球半徑 3。
（b）表面積和 = 180π cm²。

questions.stem:
13. There are two solid metal spheres. The ratio of the surface area of the smaller sphere to the surface area of the larger sphere is \(4:9\). The radius of the larger sphere is \(9\text{ cm}\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of the smaller sphere.

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into two solid right circular cones. Denote these two circular cones by \(A\) and \(B\). It is given that the height and the base radius of \(A\) are \(10\text{ cm}\) and \(6\text{ cm}\) respectively. A student finds that the base radius of \(B\) is \(12\text{ cm}\). The student claims that \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(4:9\)，較大球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(6\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底半徑為 \(12\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Since the surface area ratio is \(4:9\), the radius ratio is \(2:3\), and the volume ratio is \(8:27\). Therefore \[V_{\text{smaller}}=\frac{8}{27}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of \(A\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(10)=120\pi.\] The volume of \(B\) is \[288\pi+\frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3-120\pi=1140\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_B}{V_A}=\frac{1140\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19}{2}.\] If \(A\) and \(B\) were similar, the volume ratio should be \[\left(\frac{12}{6}\right)^3=8.\] Since \(8\ne \frac{19}{2}\), \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. Final answers: (a) \(288\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) no.

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(14\text{ cm}\) and \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times the curved surface area of \(X\).

(i) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into 2 identical solid spheres, find the diameter of each sphere.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(14\) cm 及 \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(15\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心球，求每個球的直徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(l\) be the slant height of the circular cone. Since the curved surface area is \(700\pi\), \[\pi(14)l=700\pi.\] Thus \[ l=50. \] The height is \[\sqrt{50^2-14^2}=48\text{ cm}.\] (b)(i) Since the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times that of \(X\), the whole cone has curved surface area \(16\) times that of \(X\). Therefore the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the volume of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{64}\) of the volume of the whole cone. The volume of the whole cone is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(14)^2(48)=3136\pi.\) Hence \(V_Y=3136\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{64}\right)=3087\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b)(ii) If the diameter of each sphere is \(d\), then \(2\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^3=3087\pi.\) Solving gives \(d=21.\) Final answers: (a) \(48\text{ cm}\); (b)(i) \(3087\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b)(ii) \(21\text{ cm}\).

questions.stem:
14. The height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 45 cm and 24 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a circular cone and a frustum \(X\) by a plane parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(X\) is 30 cm.

(a) Express the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(X\) is melted and recast into a solid cube. Does the total surface area of the cube exceed the total surface area of \(X\)? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐及一個截頭錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(30\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。

(c) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心立方體。立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(X\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) The height of the small cone is \[45-30=15\text{ cm}.\] The small cone is similar to the original cone with linear scale factor \[\frac{15}{45}=\frac13.\] Therefore the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\left(\frac13\right)^3\right) =8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] The radius and slant height of the small cone are respectively \[8\text{ cm} \text{and} 17\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17).\] The two circular faces have total area \[\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17)+\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2 =1728\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (c) Let the side length of the cube be \(x\) cm. Since the volume is unchanged, \[x^3=8320\pi.\] Thus \[x\approx 29.6773.\] The total surface area of the cube is \[6x^2\approx 5284.45\text{ cm}^2.\] Also, \[1728\pi\approx 5428.67\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[5284.45<5428.67,\] the total surface area of the cube does not exceed the total surface area of \(X\). Final answers: (a) \(8320\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (c) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐高 15，線性比 1/3：
\[
V_X=\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\frac1{27}\right)=8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）原錐斜高 51。小錐半徑 8、斜高 17。

questions.stem:
12. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base area \(96\pi\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(38\) cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the base area of the smaller circular cone to the base area of the larger circular cone is \(9:25\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller circular cone.

(b) If the base radius of the smaller circular cone is \(6\) cm, find the curved surface area of the larger circular cone correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底面積 \(96\pi\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(38\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐與較大圓錐的底面積比為 \(9:25\)。

(a) 求較小圓錐的體積。

(b) 若較小圓錐的底半徑為 \(6\) cm，求較大圓錐的曲面面積，準確至最接近的 cm\(^2\)。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The volume of the cylinder is \(96\pi(38)=3648\pi.\) The base areas of the smaller and larger cones are in the ratio \(9:25\), so their linear ratio is \(3:5\) and their volume ratio is \(27:125\). (a) \[V_{\text{smaller}}=3648\pi\cdot\frac{27}{27+125} =\boxed{648\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the height of the smaller cone be \(h\). Since its base radius is \(6\) cm, \[\frac13\pi(6)^2h=648\pi,\] so \[ h=54. \] The slant height of the smaller cone is \[\sqrt{6^2+54^2}=6\sqrt{82}.\] The curved surface area of the smaller cone is \[\pi(6)(6\sqrt{82})=36\pi\sqrt{82}.\] The ratio of the curved surface areas is \(9:25\). Hence the curved surface area of the larger cone is \[36\pi\sqrt{82}\cdot\frac{25}{9}=100\pi\sqrt{82}\approx \boxed{2845\text{ cm}^2}.\]

questions.stem:
13. The slant height and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are 29 cm and \(580 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top part is a right circular cone \(A\), the middle part is a frustum \(B\) and the bottom part is a frustum \(C\). The curved surface areas of \(A\) and \(B\) are equal. The curved surface area of \(C\) is 6 times the curved surface area of \(A\).

(i) Express the volume of \(C\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(C\) is melted and recast into 5 identical solid metal right circular cylinders with the height 10 cm , find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的斜高及曲面面積分別為 \(29\) cm 及 \(580\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(A\)，中部為截頭錐 \(B\)，底部為截頭錐 \(C\)。\(A\) 與 \(B\) 的曲面面積相等，\(C\) 的曲面面積為 \(A\) 的 \(6\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(C\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(C\) 熔化重鑄成 \(5\) 個高 \(10\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱，求每個圓柱的底半徑。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. Since the slant height is \(29\) cm and the curved surface area is \(580\pi\), \[\pi r(29)=580\pi.\] Hence \(r=20\). The height is \[\sqrt{29^2-20^2}=\boxed{21\text{ cm}}.\] (b)(i) The curved surface areas of \(A,B,C\) are in the ratio \(1:1:6\). Hence the combined top cone \(A+B\) has curved surface area \(\frac14\) of the original cone, so its linear scale factor is \(\frac12\). Its volume scale factor is \(\frac18\). The volume of the original cone is \(\frac13\pi(20)^2(21)=2800\pi.\) Therefore, \(V_C=\frac78(2800\pi)=\boxed{2450\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\) (b)(ii) Each cylinder has volume \(\frac{2450\pi}{5}=490\pi.\) If the base radius is \(R\) cm, then \(\pi R^2(10)=490\pi,\) so \(\boxed{R=7}.\)

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\). The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Someone claims that the curved surface area of \(Z\) is twice the curved surface area of \(X\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。

(c) 切除 \(Y\) 的上部造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的兩倍。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The volume of the original cylinder is \(\pi(10)^2(4.2)=420\pi.\) Since the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) are in the ratio \(4:9\), their radii are in the ratio \(2:3\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(8:27\). (a) \[V_Y=420\pi\cdot\frac{27}{8+27}=\boxed{324\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the radius and height of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and \(4k\) respectively. Then \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi,\] so \(12k^3=324\), \(k=3\). Hence \(r_Y=9\), \(h_Y=12\), and the slant height is \(15\). Therefore, \[\text{curved surface area of }Y=\pi(9)(15)=\boxed{135\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\] (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar, \(r_X=6\), \(h_X=8\), and the slant height of \(X\) is \(10\). Thus \[\text{CSA of }X=\pi(6)(10)=60\pi.\] In \(Y\), the frustum \(Z\) has height \(8\), so the removed top cone has height \(4\), with linear scale factor \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac13\). Its curved surface area is \[\frac{1}{9}(135\pi)=15\pi.\] Therefore, \[\text{CSA of }Z=135\pi-15\pi=120\pi=2(60\pi).\] The claim is correct.

Since the height of \(C\) is \(27\) cm, \[\frac13\pi r^2(27)=729\pi,\] so \(r=9\). The slant height of \(B\) is \[\sqrt{6^2+18^2}=6\sqrt{10}.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(B\) is \[\pi(6)^2+\pi(6)(6\sqrt{10}) =\boxed{36\pi(1+\sqrt{10})\ \text{cm}^2}.\]

questions.stem:
12. In a workshop, \(9\) identical solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are melted and recast into a circular cone. It is given that the base radius of the cone is \(18\) cm.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of \(Y\) is \(8:19\). Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
12. 某工作坊將 \(9\) 個半徑 \(6\) cm 的相同實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個圓錐。已知圓錐的底半徑為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積比為 \(8:19\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) The total volume of the \(9\) spheres is \[9\left(\frac43\pi(6)^3\right)=2592\pi.\] Let the height of the cone be \(h\) cm. Then \[\frac13\pi(18)^2h=2592\pi,\] so \[h=\boxed{24\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The slant height of the whole cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] The curved surface area of the whole cone is \[\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\] Since \(V_X:V_Y=8:19\), we have \[V_X:V_{\text{whole}}=8:27.\] Thus the linear ratio of \(X\) to the whole cone is \(2:3\), and the curved surface area ratio is \(4:9\). Hence \[\text{curved surface area of }Y =540\pi\left(1-\frac49\right) =\boxed{300\pi\text{ cm}^2}.\]

questions.stem:
12. A solid metal right circular cylinder with base radius 16 cm and height 57 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the base area of the smaller cone to the base area of the larger cone is \(9: 25\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller cone in terms of \(\pi\).
(3 marks)

(b) Someone claims that, if the height of the smaller cone is 24 cm , the total surface area of the cylinder equals the sum of the total surface areas of the two similar cones. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底半徑 \(16\) cm、高 \(57\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐與較大圓錐的底面積比為 \(9:25\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的體積。（3 分）

(b) 某人聲稱若較小圓錐的高為 \(24\) cm，圓柱的總表面積等於兩個相似圓錐的總表面積之和。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The volume of the cylinder is \(\pi(16)^2(57)=14592\pi.\) The base areas of the smaller and larger cones are in the ratio \(9:25\), so their linear ratio is \(3:5\) and their volume ratio is \(27:125\). (a) \[V_{\text{smaller}}=14592\pi\cdot\frac{27}{27+125} =\boxed{2592\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) If the height of the smaller cone is \(24\) cm, then \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=2592\pi,\] so \(r=18\) cm. The larger cone has radius \(30\) cm and height \(40\) cm. The slant heights of the smaller and larger cones are \(30\) cm and \(50\) cm respectively. The sum of their total surface areas is \(\pi(18)^2+\pi(18)(30)+\pi(30)^2+\pi(30)(50)=3264\pi.\) The total surface area of the cylinder is \(2\pi(16)^2+2\pi(16)(57)=2336\pi.\) Since \(3264\pi\ne2336\pi\), the claim is not correct.

questions.stem:

The circular cone is divided into a circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane parallel to its base. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of \(X\) to the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(1:8\).

(a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) \(X\) and \(Y\) are melted and recast into two similar solid circular cylinders \(W\) and \(Z\) respectively. If the base radius of \(Z\) is 6 cm, does the total surface area of \(W\) exceed \(700\text{ cm}^2\)? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(54\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積比為 \(1:8\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 分別熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓柱 \(W\) 及 \(Z\)。若 \(Z\) 的底半徑為 \(6\) cm，\(W\) 的總表面積是否超過 \(700\text{ cm}^2\)？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let the curved surface area of the original cone be \(S\). Since the ratio of the curved surface area of \(X\) to that of \(Y\) is \(1:8\), the curved surface area of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{9}S.\) For similar cones, the ratio of curved surface areas is the square of the ratio of corresponding lengths. Hence the ratio of the base radius of \(X\) to the base radius of the original cone is \(1:3.\) Therefore, the ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of the original cone is \(1:27.\) The volume of the original cone is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(54)=5832\pi.\) Hence the volume of \(Y\) is \(\left(1-\frac{1}{27}\right)(5832\pi)=5616\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) Let \(h\) cm be the height of \(Z\). Since \(Y\) is recast into \(Z\), \(\pi(6)^2h=5616\pi.\) Thus \(h=156.\) The total surface area of \(Z\) is \(2\pi(6)^2+2\pi(6)(156)=1944\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The volume ratio of \(W\) to \(Z\) is the same as the volume ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\): \(1:26.\) Since \(W\) and \(Z\) are similar, their total surface areas are in the ratio \(1:26^{2/3}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(W\) is \(\frac{1944\pi}{26^{2/3}}\text{ cm}^2.\) \[\frac{1944\pi}{26^{2/3}}\approx 695.9<700.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(W\) does not exceed \(700\text{ cm}^2\). ------------------(4)

It is given that the radii of the upper base and the lower base of the frustum \(Y\) are \(r\text{ cm}\) and \(3r\text{ cm}\) respectively. The height of the frustum \(Y\) is \(2r\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find, in terms of \(\pi\) and \(r\), the volume of \(Y\).

(b) \(Y\) is melted and recast into \(k\) identical solid hemispheres \(Z\) with radius \(r\text{ cm}\). Find \(k\).

(c) Find the least number of solid hemispheres \(Z\) such that the total surface area of the hemispheres would exceed that of \(Y\).
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 的上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(r\) cm 及 \(3r\) cm，\(Y\) 的高為 \(2r\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 及 \(r\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成 \(k\) 個半徑 \(r\) cm 的相同實心半球 \(Z\)，求 \(k\)。

(c) 求最少需要多少個實心半球 \(Z\)，使其總表面積超過 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Since the radii of the smaller cone and larger cone are in the ratio \(1:3\), their heights are also in the ratio \(1:3\). The height of the frustum is \(2r\), so the height of the smaller cone is \(r\), and the height of the larger cone is \(3r\). The volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac13\pi(3r)^2(3r)-\frac13\pi r^2(r).\) Thus \(\text{Volume of }Y=9\pi r^3-\frac13\pi r^3=\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3.\) (b) The volume of one solid hemisphere of radius \(r\) is \[\frac23\pi r^3.\] Since \(Y\) is recast into \(k\) identical hemispheres, \[\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3=k\left(\frac23\pi r^3\right).\] Therefore, \[ k=13. \] (c) The slant height of the frustum is \[\sqrt{(2r)^2+(2r)^2}=2\sqrt2r.\] The total surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi r^2+\pi(3r)^2+\pi(r+3r)(2\sqrt2r).\] Hence \[\text{Total surface area of }Y=(10+8\sqrt2)\pi r^2.\] The total surface area of one solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Let \(n\) be the required number of hemispheres. Then \[n(3\pi r^2)>(10+8\sqrt2)\pi r^2.\] Thus \[n>\frac{10+8\sqrt2}{3}\approx 7.10.\] Therefore, the least possible value of \(n\) is \(8.\)

V_Y=9\pi r^3-\frac13\pi r^3=\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3.
\]
（b）半球 = (2/3)πr³。(26/3)πr³ = k(2/3)πr³，k = 13。

(a) Volume of the hemisphere \(=\frac{3}{2} \times\) volume of the cone \[\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3} =\frac{3}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2}(r+6) 1 \mathrm{M}+1 \mathrm{M} \\ 4 r^{3} =3 r^{3}+18 r^{2} \\ r^{3}-18 r^{2} =0 1 \mathrm{~A}\] (b) Total surface area of the original metal solid \[ =\left[\pi(18) \sqrt{18^{2}+(18+6)^{2}}+\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi(18)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}+1 \mathrm{M} \\ =(540 \pi+648 \pi) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =1188 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Sum of the total surface areas of the 8 smaller solids \( =8 \times 1188 \pi \times\left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{8}}\right)^{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ =2376 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \approx 7464.4241 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ <7500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \therefore \text { The claim is disagreed. }\)

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius 10 cm and height 4.2 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid metal right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The ratio of the base area of \(X\) to the base area of \(Y\) is \(4:9\). The ratio of the base radius of \(Y\) to its height is \(3:4\).

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\). The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Someone claims that the curved surface area of \(Z\) is twice the curved surface area of \(X\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(4.2\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。（2 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（3 分）

(c) 切除 \(Y\) 的上部造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的兩倍。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[\pi(10)^2(4.2)=420\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the base area ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(4:9\), the base radius ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2:3.\) As \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar, the volume ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2^3:3^3=8:27.\) Hence \(\text{Volume of }Y=420\pi\times\frac{27}{8+27}=324\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius and height of \(Y\) be \(3k\) cm and \(4k\) cm respectively. Then \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=324,\qquad k^3=27,\qquad k=3.\) The base radius and height of \(Y\) are 9 cm and 12 cm respectively. The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{9^2+12^2}=15.\) Therefore the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(9)(15)=135\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since the curved surface area ratio of two similar cones equals the square of their corresponding length ratio, \[\frac{\text{curved surface area of }X}{\text{curved surface area of }Y}=\frac{4}{9}.\] Thus \(\text{curved surface area of }X=135\pi\times\frac{4}{9}=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since the height ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2:3\), the height of \(X\) is \(12\times\frac{2}{3}=8\text{ cm}.\) Hence the height of \(Z\) is also 8 cm. The small cone removed from \(Y\) has height \(12-8=4\) cm, so its linear scale compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac{1}{3}\). Therefore \(\text{curved surface area of }Z =135\pi-135\pi\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2 =120\pi.\) Since \(120\pi=2(60\pi),\) the claim is correct. (8 marks)

questions.solution: 13. The volume of \(X\) is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\). The larger sphere has radius twice that of the smaller sphere, so its volume is 8 times the smaller sphere's volume. (b) Now a craftsman measures the height of the larger pyramid to be 30 cm . The craftsman claims that the total surface area of the smaller pyramid exceeds \(1500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree ? questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，三部分高度相等。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 中間部分的體積；

(b) 中間部分的總表面積。（8 分）

questions.solution: 13. (a) The largest cone has radius 18 cm and height 24 cm, so its volume is \[\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi.\] The cone is divided into three equal heights. By similarity, the volume ratios of the three parts from top to bottom are \[1^3:(2^3-1^3):(3^3-2^3)=1:7:19.\] Hence the volume of the middle part is \[\frac{7}{27}(2592\pi)=672\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the largest cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the largest cone is \[\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\] The curved surface area ratios of the three similar cones are \(1^2:2^2:3^2\), so the curved surface area of the middle frustum is \[\frac{3}{9}(540\pi)=180\pi.\] Adding the two circular ends with radii 6 cm and 12 cm gives \[180\pi+\pi(6)^2+\pi(12)^2=360\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Marks follow the marking scheme: formula and similarity ratio method marks, with final answers \(672\pi\text{ cm}^3\) and \(360\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Total: 8 marks.

(a) Find the base radius of \(X\). (3 marks)

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) \(X\) is divided into a circular cone \(Y\) and a frustum \(Z\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The volume of \(Z\) is 26 times the volume of \(Y\). 13. 兩個實心金屬球的半徑分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(12\) cm，熔化後重鑄成一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(24\) cm。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。（3 分）

(c) \(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Z\)。\(Z\) 的體積為 \(Y\) 的 \(26\) 倍。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於 \(X\) 的總表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

questions.solution: 13. (a) The total volume of the two spheres is \[\frac43\pi(6)^3+\frac43\pi(12)^3=2592\pi.\] Let the base radius of \(X\) be \(r\) cm. Since the height of \(X\) is 24 cm, \(\frac13\pi r^2(24)=2592\pi.\) Thus \(8r^2=2592,\) so \(r=18.\) (b) The slant height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \(\pi(18)(30)+\pi(18)^2=864\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since the volume of \(Z\) is 26 times the volume of \(Y\), the volume of \(X\) is 27 times the volume of \(Y\). Hence the linear scale factor from \(Y\) to \(X\) is \(1:3\). Thus the radius and slant height of \(Y\) are \(6\text{ cm} \text{and} 10\text{ cm}\) respectively. The curved surface area of \(Z\) is \(\pi(18)(30)-\pi(6)(10)=480\pi.\) The two circular faces of \(Z\) have total area \(\pi(18)^2+\pi(6)^2=360\pi.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(Z\) is \(480\pi+360\pi=840\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(840\pi<864\pi,\) the claim is not agreed. (a) Find the volume of the frustum in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The frustum is melted and recast into two identical solid spheres.

(i) Find the radius of each sphere in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Determine whether the total surface area of the two spheres is greater than the total surface area of the original frustum. Explain your answer.

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 將截頭錐熔化重鑄成兩個相同實心球。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求每個球的半徑。
(ii) 判斷兩個球的總表面積是否大於原截頭錐的總表面積。試解釋你的答案。
（4 分）

questions.solution: (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the small cone cut off. By similarity, \(\frac{h}{h+12}=\frac59\), giving \(h=15\). Thus the frustum volume is \[\frac13\pi(9^2)(27)-\frac13\pi(5^2)(15)=604\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Let the radius of each sphere be \(r\) cm. By conservation of volume, \(2\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)=604\pi,\) so \(r^3=\frac{453}{2}\) and \(r=\sqrt[3]{\frac{453}{2}}\text{ cm}\approx6.095\text{ cm}.\) (ii) The slant height of the frustum is \(\sqrt{12^2+(9-5)^2}=4\sqrt{10}\) cm. 14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑為 \(20\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(X\)，中部為截頭錐 \(Y\)，底部為截頭錐 \(Z\)。圓錐 \(X\) 與截頭錐 \(Z\) 的高相等，截頭錐 \(Y\) 的高為圓錐 \(X\) 的兩倍。已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(520\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求直立圓錐的高。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐 \(Y\) 的體積。（2 分）

(c) 將截頭錐 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成一個球。球的總表面積是否超過截頭錐 \(Y\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \( A_{x} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}, A_{y} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \) and \( A_{z} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \) be the curved surface area of \( X, Y \) and \( Z \) respectively \(A_{x}:\left(A_{x}+A_{y}\right):\left(A_{x}+A_{y}+A_{z}\right)=1^{2}: 3^{2}: 4^{2} \\ =1: 9: 16 \\ \therefore A_{x}: A_{y}: A_{z}=1: 8: 7\) Let \( l \mathrm{~cm} \) be the slant height of the cone \[\pi(20)(l) \times \frac{8}{16} =520 \pi \\ l =52\] \[\therefore \text { Height of the cone } =\sqrt{52^{2}-20^{2}} \\ =48 \mathrm{~cm}\] (b) \[\text { Volume of } Y =\frac{1}{3} \pi(20)^{2}(48) \times \frac{3^{3}-1^{3}}{4^{3}} \\ =2600 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (c) Total surface area of \( Y=520 \pi+\pi\left(20 \times \frac{1}{4}\right)^{2}+\pi\left(20 \times \frac{3}{4}\right)^{2} \) \(=770 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Let \( r \mathrm{~cm} \) be the radius of the sphere \(\frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3} =2600 \pi \\ r =\sqrt[3]{1950}\) \(\text { Total surface area of the sphere } =4 \pi(\sqrt[3]{1950})^{2} \\ \approx 624.3331554 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ <770 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ No. The total surface area of the sphere does not exceed that of frustum \( Y \).

某實心金屬球體被放於一個圓柱形容器中。已知球體的半徑與容器的底半徑相同。飛飛把 \(1152 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 的水倒進容器內使得該球體剛好浸沒於水中。 （a）求該球體的半徑。 （b）把該球體從容器中取出並將它溶解及重鑄成一個底半徑與容器相同的直立圓錐體。然後把該圓錐體放回容器中。 （i）寫出該圓錐的高度。 （ii）飛飛宣稱容器內水位的高度高於圓錐體高度的一半。他的宣稱正確嗎？試解釋你的答案。

13. 某實心金屬球體被放於一個圓柱形容器中。已知球體的半徑與容器的底半徑相同。Faye 把 \(1152\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 的水倒進容器內，使該球體剛好浸沒於水中。

(a) 求該球體的半徑。

(b) 把該球體從容器中取出，熔化後重鑄成一個底半徑與容器相同的直立圓錐，然後把圓錐放回容器中。

(i) 寫出該圓錐的高。
(ii) Faye 聲稱容器內水位的高度高於圓錐高度的一半。他的聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）

questions.solution: 13. (a) Let the radius of the sphere be \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). \[ \frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3}+1152 \pi=\pi r^{2}(2 r) \\ r^{3}=1728 \\ \therefore r=12\] The radius of the sphere is 12 cm . (b) (i) Let the height of the cone be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\). \[\frac{4}{3} \pi(12)^{3}=\frac{1}{3} \pi(12)^{2} h\] \[\therefore h=48\] The height of the cone is 48 cm . (ii) Half of the height of the cone is 24 cm . Volume of the frustum of the cone with height 24 cm \(=\frac{1}{3} \pi(12)^{2}(48)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(6)^{2}(24)\) \(=2016 \pi\) Space in the container with height 24 cm \(=\pi(12)^{2}(24)-2016 \pi\) \(=1440 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}>1152 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) The water level is lower than half of the height of the cone. The claim is not correct. f.t.

questions.stem:
13. There are two solid metal spheres. The ratio of the radius of the smaller sphere to the radius of the larger sphere is \(3: 5\). The curved surface area of the larger sphere is \(900 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of the smaller sphere.

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into two solid right square based pyramids. Denote these two pyramids by \(A\) and \(B\). It is given that the length of a side of the base and the height of \(A\) are 20 cm and 15 cm respectively. A student finds that the length of a side of the base of \(B\) is 40 cm . The student claims that \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的半徑比為 \(3:5\)，較大球的曲面面積為 \(900\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立正方形底錐體，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的底邊長及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(15\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底邊長為 \(40\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
13. (a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger sphere \( 4 \pi r^{2}=900 \pi \\ r=15\) 
 Radius of the smaller sphere \(=9 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Volume of the smaller sphere \[ =\frac{4}{3} \pi(9)^{3} \\ =972 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) The volume of \(A\) 
 \(=\frac{1}{3}(20)^{2}(15)\) 
 \(=2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 The volume of \(B\) 
 \(=972 \pi+\frac{4}{3} \pi(15)^{3}-2000\) 
 \(\approx 15191 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 \(\frac{\text { volume of } B}{\text { volume of } A}=\frac{15191}{2000} \approx 7.60\) 
 \(\left(\frac{\text { length of a side of base of } B}{\text { length of a side of base of } A}\right)^{3}=8\) 
 \(8 \neq 7.60\) 
 Thus, \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. The claim is not correct. Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(B\). 
 \(\frac{1}{3}(40)^{2}(h)=15191\) 
 \(h \approx 28.5\) 
 \(\frac{\text { height of } B}{\text { height of } A}=\frac{28.5}{15} \approx 1.90\) 
 \(\frac{\text { length of a side of base of } B}{\text { length of a side of base of } A}=2\) 
 \(2 \neq 1.90\) 
 Thus, \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. The claim is not correct.

questions.stem:
10. There are two solid metal spheres. The ratio of the volume of the smaller sphere to the volume of the larger sphere is \(27: 64\). The radius of the smaller sphere is 18 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the surface area of the larger sphere.

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into a solid right circular cone \(X\) and a solid right circular cylinder \(Y\). It is given that the heights of \(X\) and \(Y\) are 30 cm and 22 cm respectively. A student finds that the base area of \(X\) is equal to the surface area of the larger sphere. Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(Y\).
questions.stemZh:
10. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的體積比為 \(27:64\)，較小球半徑為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大球的表面積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\) 及一個實心直立圓柱 \(Y\)。已知 \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(30\) cm 及 \(22\) cm，某學生量得 \(X\) 的底面積等於較大球的表面積。以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 10. (a) The ratio of the surface area of the smaller sphere to the surface area of the larger sphere is \(9: 16\). Surface area of the larger sphere \[=4 \pi(18)^{2}\left(\frac{16}{9}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=2304 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] The ratio of the radius of the smaller sphere to the radius of the larger sphere is \(3: 4\). Radius of the larger sphere \(=18\left(\frac{4}{3}\right) \mathrm{cm}=24 \mathrm{~cm}\) Surface area of the larger sphere \[=4 \pi(24)^{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] \[=2304 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(X\). \[\pi r^{2}=2304 \pi\] \[r=48 \text { or }-48 \text { (rejected) }\] ∴ The base radius of \(X\) is 48 cm . Volume of \(X\) \[=\frac{1}{3} \pi(48)^{2}(30) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=23040 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Volume of \(Y\) \[=\left[\frac{4}{3} \pi(18)^{3}+\frac{4}{3} \pi(18)^{3}\left(\frac{64}{27}\right)-23040 \pi\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=3168 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Volume of \(Y\) \[=\left[\frac{4}{3} \pi(18)^{3}+\frac{4}{3} \pi(24)^{3}-23040 \pi\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=3168 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Y\). \[\pi R^{2}(22) =3168 \pi \\ R =12 \text { or }-12 \text { (rejected) }\] ∴ The base radius of \(Y\) is 12 cm . Total surface area of \(Y\) \[=\left[2 \pi(12)^{2}+2 \pi(12)(22)\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=816 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\]

questions.stem:
14. There are 30 identical solid metal spheres each of diameter 12 cm. All the metal spheres are melted and recast into a solid right circular cone of base radius 24 cm.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The volume of \(Y\) is 7 times the volume of \(X\).

(i) Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Find the ratio of the total surface area of \(X\) to the total surface area of \(Y\).
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 有 \(30\) 個直徑 \(12\) cm 的相同實心金屬球，全部熔化後重鑄成一個底半徑 \(24\) cm 的實心直立圓錐。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的體積為 \(X\) 的 \(7\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 求 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的總表面積之比。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the circular cone. Since each sphere has radius \(6\) cm, \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(24)^2h=30\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right).\] Therefore \[192\pi h=8640\pi,\] so \[ h=45. \] The height of the circular cone is \(45\) cm. (b)(i) Since \(V_X:V_{\text{whole cone}}=1:(1+7)=1:8\), the linear scale factor of cone \(X\) to the whole cone is \(\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{8}}=\frac{1}{2}.\) The slant height of the whole cone is \(\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\) The curved surface area of the whole cone is \(\pi(24)(51)=1224\pi.\) The curved surface area of cone \(X\) is \(\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2(1224\pi)=306\pi.\) Hence the curved surface area of frustum \(Y\) is \(1224\pi-306\pi=918\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (ii) The base radius of \(X\) is \(12\) cm. Thus the total surface area of \(X\) is \[306\pi+\pi(12)^2=450\pi.\] The total surface area of \(Y\) is \[918\pi+\pi(12)^2+\pi(24)^2=1638\pi.\] Therefore the required ratio is \[450\pi:1638\pi=25:91.\]

(b) The circular cone \(A\) is melted and recast into a solid sphere and the frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into a solid right circular cylinder. It is given that the radius of the sphere and the base radius of the cylinder are the same. Someone claims that the total surface area of the cylinder is at least twice the total surface area of the sphere. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(4 marks)

13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑為 \(36\) cm，高為 \(18\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(A\) 及一個截頭錐 \(B\)。已知 \(B\) 的高為 \(6\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將圓錐 \(A\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心球，截頭錐 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心直立圓柱。已知球的半徑與圓柱的底半徑相同。某人聲稱圓柱的總表面積最少為球的總表面積的兩倍。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。

questions.solution:
13(a) Volume of the original cone \(=\frac{1}{3} \pi(36)^{2}(18)\) \(=7776 \pi\) 
 ∴ Volume of \(B=7776 \pi \times \frac{18^{3}-(18-6)^{3}}{18^{3}}\) \(=5472 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Let the base radius of the cylinder be \(r \mathrm{~cm}\), the height of the cylinder be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Note that the radius of the sphere \(=r\) 
 Volume of sphere \(=\frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3}=7776 \pi-5472 \pi\) \(r=12\) 
 Volume of cylinder \(=\pi(12)^{2} h=5472 \pi\) \(h=38\) 
 Total surface area of cylinder \(=2 \pi(12)(38)+2 \pi(12)^{2}\) 
 \(=1200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 Twice the total surface area of sphere 
 \(=2\left(4 \pi(12)^{2}\right)\) 
 \(=1152 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<1200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 ∴ The claim is agreed. 1 M for \(V=\frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2} h\) 
 1 M for \(V \times \frac{l_{1}^{3}-l_{2}^{3}}{l_{1}^{3}}\)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求兩個半球的總體積。

(b) 兩個半球熔化後重鑄成一個直立圓錐，圓錐的底半徑與高之比為 \(4:9\)。某人聲稱圓錐的總表面積超過 \(280\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: 12. The sum of the total surface areas of two hemispheres is \(135 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). The ratio of the curved surface area of the larger hemisphere to the curved surface area of the smaller hemisphere is \(4: 1\). (a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total volume of the two hemispheres. (4 marks) (b) The two hemispheres are melted and recast into a right circular cone. The ratio of the base radius of the circular cone to the height of the circular cone is \(4: 9\). Someone claims that the total surface area of the circular cone exceeds \(280 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks) (a) radius of the larger hemisphere: radius of the smaller hemisphere \(=\sqrt{\left(\frac{4}{1}\right)}=\frac{2}{1} 1 \mathrm{~A}\) Let \(r\) and \(2 r\) be the radius of the smaller and larger hemisphere respectively, \[3 \pi(r)^{2}+3 \pi(2 r)^{2} =135 \pi \\ r =3\] ∴ Volume of the smaller hemisphere \( =\frac{2}{3} \pi(3)^{3}+\frac{2}{3} \pi(6)^{3}\) \[=\underline{\underline{162 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}}}\] (b) Let \(4 k\) and \(k\) be the radius and the height of the circular cone respectively. \[162 \pi =\frac{1}{3} \pi(4 k)^{2}(9 k) \\ k^{3} =3.375 \\ k =1.5\] The total surface area of the circular cone \(=\pi(4 \times 1.5)^{2}+\pi(4 \times 1.5)\left(\sqrt{(4 \times 1.5)^{2}+(9 \times 1.5)^{2}} 1 \mathrm{M}\right.\) \( =391.56 \ldots \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ >280 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is correct. 1f.t.
