questions.stem:
12. Four solid metal right circular cones of base radius 25 cm and height 28 cm are melted and recast into two different hemispheres. Given that the ratio of the radius of the smaller hemisphere to the radius of the larger hemisphere is \(2:3\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Find the percentage change in total surface area. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 四個底半徑 \(25\) cm、高 \(28\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓錐熔化後，重鑄成兩個不同的半球。已知較小半球與較大半球的半徑比為 \(2:3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大半球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 求總表面積的百分數變化。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let \(2r\) cm and \(3r\) cm be the radii of the smaller hemisphere and the larger hemisphere respectively. \[4\left[\frac{1}{3}\pi(25)^2(28)\right] =\frac{2}{3}\pi(2r)^3+\frac{2}{3}\pi(3r)^3.\] \(r^3=1000,\) so \(r=10\). The volume of the larger hemisphere is \(\frac{2}{3}\pi(3\times10)^3=18000\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) The total surface area of the four circular cones is \[4\{\pi(25)^2+\pi(25)\sqrt{25^2+28^2}\}\] \[=(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] The total surface area of the two hemispheres is \(3\pi(2\times10)^2+3\pi(3\times10)^2=3900\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The percentage change in total surface area is \(\frac{3900\pi-(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi}{(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi}\times100\%.\) \[\approx -37.63656868\%.\] Therefore, the total surface area is decreased by \(37.6\%\), correct to 3 significant figures. ------------------(4)

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal right prism of base area \(76\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(12\text{ cm}\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids. The bases of the two pyramids are squares. The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(9:25\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller pyramid.

(b) If the height of the smaller pyramid is \(6\text{ cm}\), find the total surface area of the larger pyramid.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底面積 \(76\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(12\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(9:25\)。

(a) 求較小錐的體積。

(b) 若較小錐的高為 \(6\) cm，求較大錐的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the prism is \[76\times 12=912\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the base-area ratio of the two similar pyramids is \(9:25\), their linear ratio is \[ 3:5. \] Thus their volume ratio is \[3^3:5^3=27:125.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[912\times \frac{27}{27+125}=162\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the side length of the square base of the smaller pyramid be \(x\) cm. Then \[\frac{1}{3}x^2(6)=162.\] Hence \[x^2=81,\] so \[ x=9. \] The slant height of the smaller pyramid is \(\sqrt{4.5^2+6^2}=7.5\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of the smaller pyramid is \(9^2+4\left(\frac{1}{2}\times 9\times 7.5\right)=216\text{ cm}^2.\) The surface-area ratio of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(9:25\). Hence the total surface area of the larger pyramid is \(216\times \frac{25}{9}=600\text{ cm}^2.\)

questions.stem:
13. A sphere is melted and recast into 2 similar cones. The radius of the sphere is 6 cm. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the 2 cones is \(25:4\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller cone. (4 marks)

(b) If the base radius of the smaller cone is 2 cm, is the total curved surface area of the 2 cones larger than the surface area of the sphere? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個球熔化後重鑄成兩個相似圓錐，球半徑為 \(6\) cm。已知兩圓錐的曲面面積比為 \(25:4\)。

(a) 求較小圓錐的體積。（4 分）

(b) 若較小圓錐的底半徑為 \(2\) cm，兩圓錐的總曲面面積是否大於球的表面積？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the sphere is \[\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The ratio of the curved surface areas of the two similar cones is \(25:4\), so their linear ratio is \(5:2.\) Hence their volume ratio is \(5^3:2^3=125:8.\) Therefore the volume of the smaller cone is \(288\pi\times\frac{8}{125+8} =\frac{2304\pi}{133}\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the smaller cone. Since its base radius is 2 cm, \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(2)^2h=\frac{2304\pi}{133}.\] Thus \[h=\frac{1728}{133}.\] The slant height of the smaller cone is \(\sqrt{2^2+\left(\frac{1728}{133}\right)^2}.\) Hence its curved surface area is \(\pi(2)\sqrt{2^2+\left(\frac{1728}{133}\right)^2}.\) Since the curved surface area ratio of the larger cone to the smaller cone is \(25:4\), the total curved surface area of the two cones is \(\frac{29}{4}\) times the curved surface area of the smaller cone. Numerically, \(\text{total curved surface area}\approx598.8\text{ cm}^2.\) The surface area of the sphere is \(4\pi(6)^2\approx452.4\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(598.8>452.4\), the total curved surface area of the two cones is larger than the surface area of the sphere. (7 marks)

questions.stem:
14. The height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 72 cm and 21 cm respectively. The cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base at a height of 24 cm from the base, dividing it into a smaller cone and a frustum F.

(a) Find the volume of the frustum F in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Find the total surface area of the frustum F in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) The frustum F is melted and recast into four identical solid cubes. Does the total surface area of the four cubes exceed the total surface area of F? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(72\) cm 及 \(21\) cm。沿一個平行於底面、距底 \(24\) cm 的平面把圓錐切成一個小圓錐及一個截頭錐 \(F\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐 \(F\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐 \(F\) 的總表面積。（3 分）

(c) 將截頭錐 \(F\) 熔化重鑄成四個相同實心立方體。四個立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(F\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a) \[\text{Volume of }F =\frac{1}{3}\pi(21^2)(72)\left[1-\left(\frac{72-24}{72}\right)^3\right].\] \[=10584\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^3\right] =7448\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] ------------------(3) (b) \[\text{Total surface area of }F =\pi(21)\sqrt{21^2+72^2}\left[1-\left(\frac{72-24}{72}\right)^2\right] +\pi(21)^2+\pi\left[21\left(\frac{72-24}{72}\right)\right]^2.\] \[=1512\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] ------------------(3) (c) Let x cm be the side length of each cube. \[4x^3=7448\pi.\] \[x^3=1862\pi,\) so \(x=\sqrt[3]{1862\pi}.\] The total surface area of the four cubes is \(4\times 6\left(\sqrt[3]{1862\pi}\right)^2\text{ cm}^2\) \[\approx 7791.677009\text{ cm}^2.\] The total surface area of F is \(1512\pi\text{ cm}^2\approx 4750.088092\text{ cm}^2.\) Therefore, the total surface area of the four cubes exceeds the total surface area of F. ------------------(3)

questions.stem:
9. The total surface area of a metal solid hemisphere is \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Find the volume of the hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The hemisphere is melted and recast into \(n\) identical right circular cylinders. The base radius of each circular cylinder is half of the radius of the hemisphere while the height of each circular cylinder is \(16\) cm. Alan claims that the total curved surface area of all the circular cylinders is greater than \(5000\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 一個金屬實心半球的總表面積為 \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求半球的體積。

(b) 將半球熔化重鑄成 \(n\) 個相同直立圓柱，每個圓柱的底半徑為半球半徑的一半，高為 \(16\) cm。Alan 聲稱所有圓柱的總曲面面積大於 \(5000\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 9. (a) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the hemisphere. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \(3\pi r^2\). Hence \[3\pi r^2=1728\pi,\] so \[ r=24. \] The required volume is \[\frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 =\frac{2}{3}\pi(24)^3 =9216\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Since the base radius of each circular cylinder is \(\frac{r}{2}=12\) cm and the height is \(16\) cm, \[\pi\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^2(16n)=9216\pi.\] Thus \[\pi(12)^2(16n)=9216\pi,\] so \[ n=4. \] The total curved surface area of all the circular cylinders is \[2\pi\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)(16)(4) =2\pi(12)(16)(4) \approx 4825.486316\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[4825.486316<5000,\] the claim is disagreed.

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(A\) and a frustum \(B\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of \(A\) are \(6\) cm and \(8\) cm respectively. The curved surface area of \(B\) is \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(i) the curved surface area of \(A\),
(ii) the volume of \(B\).

(b) The frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into \(12\) identical solid right circular cylinders. The height of each circular cylinder is \(13\) cm. Find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(A\) 及一個截頭錐 \(B\)。\(A\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(8\) cm，\(B\) 的曲面面積為 \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(i) \(A\) 的曲面面積；
(ii) \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將截頭錐 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成 \(12\) 個相同的實心直立圓柱，每個圓柱高 \(13\) cm，求每個圓柱的底半徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a)(i) The slant height of \(A\) is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the curved surface area of \(A\) is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (a)(ii) Let the base radius of the original large cone be \(r\) cm. Since the curved surface areas of similar cones are proportional to the squares of corresponding lengths, \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{60\pi}{60\pi+480\pi}.\) Thus \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{1}{9},\) so \(r=18.\) By similarity, the height of the original large cone is \(8\left(\frac{18}{6}\right)=24\text{ cm}.\) The volume of cone \(A\) is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let the volume of \(B\) be \(V\text{ cm}^3\). Since volumes of similar cones are proportional to the cubes of corresponding lengths, \(\frac{96\pi}{96\pi+V}=\left(\frac{6}{18}\right)^3=\frac{1}{27}.\) Hence \(2592\pi=96\pi+V,\) so \(V=2496\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(B\) is \(2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of each circular cylinder be \(R\) cm. Then \[12\pi R^2(13)=2496\pi.\] Thus \[R^2=16,\] so \[ R=4. \] Therefore, the base radius of each circular cylinder is \[4\text{ cm}.\]

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius \(20\text{ cm}\) and height \(8.4\text{ cm}\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The ratio of the base area of \(X\) to the base area of \(Y\) is \(4:9\). The ratio of the base radius of \(Y\) to its height is \(3:4\).

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Find the curved surface area of \(Z\). (2 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(20\) cm、高 \(8.4\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（3 分）

(c) 沿一個平行於底面的平面切除 \(Y\) 的上部，造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。求 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。（2 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[\pi(20)^2(8.4)=3360\pi.\] Since the ratio of the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) is \(4:9\), the ratio of their radii is \(2:3\), and the ratio of their volumes is \(2^3:3^3=8:27.\) Therefore \(\text{volume of }Y=\frac{27}{8+27}(3360\pi)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and its height be \(4k\). \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=2592\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=2592,\) so \(k=6.\) Hence \(r=18\) and \(h=24\). The slant height is \(\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\) The curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar and the ratio of their heights is \(2:3\), \[\text{height of }X=\frac{2}{3}(24)=16.\] The height of \(Z\) is \(16\), so the removed small cone has height \(8\). Its scale factor compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{8}{24}=\frac13.\) Therefore the curved surface area of the removed small cone is \(540\pi\left(\frac13\right)^2=60\pi.\) The curved surface area of \(Z\) is \(540\pi-60\pi=480\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (8 marks)

questions.stemZh:
14. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(9:25\)，較小球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(P\) 及 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(12\) cm，某學生量得 \(Q\) 的高為 \(40\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(r\) cm. Since the ratio of surface areas is \(9:25\), \(\left(\frac{9}{r}\right)^2=\frac{9}{25}.\) Thus \(\frac{9}{r}=\frac35,\) so \(r=15.\) Therefore, the volume of the larger sphere is \(\frac43\pi(15)^3=4500\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) The volume of cone \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)^2(24)=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Let the base radius of cone \(Q\) be \(r\) cm. The total volume of the two spheres is \(\frac43\pi(9)^3+4500\pi.\) Thus \(\frac13\pi r^2(40)=\frac43\pi(9)^3+4500\pi-1152\pi.\) Hence \(\frac{40}{3}r^2=4320,\) so \(r=18.\) Now \(\frac{\text{base radius of }P}{\text{base radius of }Q}=\frac{12}{18}=\frac23,\) but \(\frac{\text{height of }P}{\text{height of }Q}=\frac{24}{40}=\frac35.\) The ratios are different, so \(P\) and \(Q\) are not similar. The claim is not agreed. (8 marks)

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base area \(364\pi\text{ cm}^2\) and height 25 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the base area of the smaller circular cone to the base area of the larger circular cone is \(9:16\).

(a) Express the volume of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) If the height of the smaller circular cone is 36 cm, express the total surface area of the larger circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底面積 \(364\pi\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(25\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐與較大圓錐的底面積比為 \(9:16\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的體積。（3 分）

(b) 若較小圓錐的高為 \(36\) cm，以 \(\pi\) 求較大圓錐的總表面積。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[364\pi(25)=9100\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the ratio of the base areas of the smaller cone to the larger cone is \(9:16\), the ratio of their corresponding lengths is \(3:4.\) Thus, the ratio of their volumes is \(3^3:4^3=27:64.\) Therefore, the volume of the smaller cone is \(\frac{27}{27+64}(9100\pi)=2700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) The base area of the smaller cone is \[\frac{3(2700\pi)}{36}=225\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Hence the radius of the smaller cone is \(15\text{ cm}.\) Since the cones are similar and their corresponding lengths are in the ratio \(3:4\), the radius and height of the larger cone are \(20\text{ cm}\) and \(48\text{ cm}\) respectively. The slant height of the larger cone is \(\sqrt{20^2+48^2}=52\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of the larger cone is \(\pi(20)^2+\pi(20)(52).\) \[=400\pi+1040\pi=1440\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] ------------------(4)

 \(\frac{\text { radius of the smaller cylinder }}{\text { radius of the larger cylinder }}=\frac{1}{2} \neq \frac{3}{5}\)

(a) Find the height of \(Y\).

(b) \( X\) and \(Y\) are melted and recast into a solid metal right cylinder \(Z\). The base radius of \(Z\) is 20 cm .

14. 實心金屬直立圓柱 \(X\) 的底半徑及曲面面積，與實心金屬直立圓錐 \(Y\) 的底半徑及曲面面積分別相等。\(X\) 的半徑及高分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(13\) cm。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的高。

(b) 將 \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心金屬直立圓柱 \(Z\)，\(Z\) 的底半徑為 \(20\) cm。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 某人聲稱 \(X\) 與 \(Z\) 相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
14. (a) The curved surface area of \(X=2 \pi(10)(13)\) \[=260 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Let the slant height of \(Y\) be \(l \mathrm{~cm}\) The curved surface area of \(Y =\pi(10) l\) \(=10 \mathrm{l} \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(\therefore 260 \pi=10 l \pi\) \(l=26\) \(\text { Height of } Y=\sqrt{26^{2}-10^{2}} 1 \mathrm{M} \\ =24 \mathrm{~cm} 1 \mathrm{~A}\) (b) {(i)} Volume of \(X =\pi\left(10^{2}\right)(13)=1300 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Volume of \(Y=\frac{1}{3} \pi\left(10^{2}\right)(24)=800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Volume of \(Z\) 
 \( =1300 \pi+800 \pi \\ =2100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 (b) (ii) \(\frac{\text { Volume of } X}{\text { Volume of } Z}=\frac{1300 \pi}{2100 \pi}\) \[= \frac{13}{21} \\ \left(\frac{\text { radius of } X}{\text { radius of } Z}\right)^{3} =\left(\frac{10}{20}\right)^{3} \\ =\frac{1}{8} \\ \neq \frac{13}{21}\] for comparing corresponding ratios Hence, I do not agree. f.t. 14. (b) (ii) Let the height of \(Z\) be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\). Volume of \(Z=2100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}=\pi(20)^{2} h\) \(h=\frac{21}{4}\) \(\frac{\text { Height of } X}{\text { Height of } Z} =\frac{13}{\left(\frac{21}{4}\right)} \\ \neq \frac{1}{2}\) \(\therefore X\) and \(Z\) are not similar. Hence, I do not agree. f.t.

13. A solid metal hemisphere of radius 12 cm is melted and recast into two solid metal right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The base radius and the curved surface area of \(X\) are 8 cm and \(80 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) respectively.

(a) Find the volume of the hemisphere.

(b) Find the volume of \(X\).

(c) Suppose the base radius of \(Y\) is 16 cm . Mr. Yip claims that if \(Y\) is divided into two parts by a plane which is parallel to its base, the upper part can be identical to \(X\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個半徑 \(12\) cm 的實心金屬半球熔化後，重鑄成兩個實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(8\) cm 及 \(80\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求半球的體積。

(b) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(c) 設 \(Y\) 的底半徑為 \(16\) cm。Mr. Yip 聲稱若 \(Y\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成兩部分，上部可與 \(X\) 完全相同。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) volume of the hemisphere \(=\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \pi(12)^{3}\) \[ =1152 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3} \\ \approx 3620 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) slant height of \(X =\frac{80 \pi}{\pi(8)}\) \[ =10 \mathrm{~cm} \\ \text { height of } X =\sqrt{10^{2}-8^{2}} \\ =6 \mathrm{~cm} \\ \therefore \text { volume of } X =\frac{1}{3} \pi(8)^{2}(6) \\ =128 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3} \\ \approx 402 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (c) volume of \(Y=1152 \pi-128 \pi=1024 \pi\) height of \(Y=\frac{1024 \pi}{\frac{1}{3} \pi(16)^{2}}=12\) Note that \(\frac{\text { volume of } Y}{\text { volume of } X}=\frac{1024 \pi}{128 \pi}=\frac{8}{1}\) and \( \frac{\text { radius of } Y}{\text { radius of } X}=\frac{16}{8}=\frac{2}{1}\) As \(\frac{\text { volume of } Y}{\text { volume of } X}=\left(\frac{\text { radius of } Y}{\text { radius of } X}\right)^{3}\) \[\therefore Y\) is similar to \(X\] As volume of \(Y>\) volume of \(X\), i.e. the upper part can be identical to \(X\). \(\therefore \) Mr. Yip's claim is correct. f.t. volume of \(Y =1152 \pi-128 \pi=1024 \pi\) height of \(Y =\frac{1024 \pi}{\frac{1}{3} \pi(16)^{2}}=12\) Note that \(\frac{\text { height of } Y}{\text { height of } X}=\frac{12}{6}=\frac{2}{1}\) and \[\frac{\text { radius of } Y}{\text { radius of } X}=\frac{16}{8}=\frac{2}{1}\] As \(\frac{\text { height of } Y}{\text { height of } X}=\frac{\text { radius of } Y}{\text { radius of } X}\) \(\therefore Y\) is similar to \(X\) As height of \(Y>\) height of \(X, \) (or radius of \(Y>\) radius of \(X\) ) i.e. the upper part can be identical to \(X\). \(\therefore \) Mr. Yip's claim is correct. f.t.

questions.stem:
12. The radii of two solid metal spheres are 4 cm and 8 cm respectively. They are melted and recast into a solid right circular cone X. It is given that the height of X is 16 cm.

(a) Find the base radius of X. (2 marks)

(b) Express the total surface area of X in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) X is divided into a circular cone Y and a frustum Z by a plane parallel to its base. The volume of Z is 7 times the volume of Y. Someone claims that the total surface area of Z is greater than the total surface area of X. Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 兩個實心金屬球的半徑分別為 \(4\) cm 及 \(8\) cm，熔化後重鑄成一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（2 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的總表面積。（3 分）

(c) \(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Z\)。\(Z\) 的體積為 \(Y\) 的 \(7\) 倍。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於 \(X\) 的總表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let r cm be the base radius of X. \[\frac{4}{3}\pi(4)^3+\frac{4}{3}\pi(8)^3=\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2(16).\] \[304=16r^2,\) so \(r^2=144.\] \(r=12\) or \(-12\) (rejected). Therefore, the base radius of X is 12 cm. ------------------(2) (b) Let \(\ell\) cm be the slant height of X. \[\ell=\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=20.\] The total surface area of X is \(\pi(12)^2+\pi(12)(20)=384\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) ------------------(3) (c) Since the volume of Z is 7 times the volume of Y, the volume of X is 8 times the volume of Y. Hence the linear scale factor from Y to X is \(1:2\). The radius and slant height of Y are 6 cm and 10 cm respectively. The total surface area of Z is \(\pi(12)(20)-\pi(6)(10)+\pi(12)^2+\pi(6)^2.\) \[=240\pi-60\pi+144\pi+36\pi =360\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \(360\pi<384\pi,\) the claim is disagreed. ------------------(3)

questions.solution: 12. 42 identical solid metal spheres with radius 6 cm are melted and recast into 2 similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the height of the smaller circular cone to the height of the larger circular cone is \(1: 3\). (a) Find the volume of the larger circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (b) If the base radius of the larger circular cone is 36 cm , find the total surface area of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (a) Let \(V_{1} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the larger circular cone and \(V_{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the smaller circular cone. \[ \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{3} \\ V_{2}=\frac{1}{27} V_{1}\] \[ \text { Volume of the sphere }=\frac{4 \pi}{3} \times 6^{3} \\ \qquad V_{1}+V_{2}=12096 \pi \\ V_{1}+\frac{1}{27} V_{1}=10296 \pi \\ \frac{28}{27} V_{1}=10296 \pi \\ V_{1}=11664 \pi\] Thus, the volume of the larger circular cone is \(11664 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}, h \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(\ell \mathrm{cm}\) be the base radius, height and slant height of the smaller circular cone respectively. \[\frac{r}{36} =\frac{1}{3} \\ r =12\] \[ \text { Volume of the smaller circular cone }=\frac{1}{3} \times \pi \times 12 \\ \qquad 12096 \pi-11664 \pi=\frac{144}{3} \pi h \\ 432 \pi=\frac{144}{3} \pi h \\ h=9 \\ \ell=\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}} \\ =15\] Total surface area of the smaller circular cone \(=\left(\pi \times 12^{2}+\pi \times 12 \times 15\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=324 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\)

(a) Find the height of \(Z\). (b) Find the base radius of \(Y\). (c) Someone claims that the sum of the curved surface area of \(Y\) and the curved surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the curved surface area of \(X\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. The base radius of \(Y\) is 9 cm . \(\frac{1}{3} \times \pi(r)^{2} \times 12 =324 \pi \\ r =9\) 13. [Continued] (c) base radius of \(X\) \[=\left(\frac{20}{12}\right)(9)\] \[=15 \mathrm{~cm}\] the curved surface area of \(X\) \[ =\pi(15)\left(\sqrt{20^{2}+15^{2}}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =375 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] the curved surface area of \(Y\) \[=\pi(9)\left(\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=135 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] the curved surface area of \(Z\) \[=2 \pi(7)(24) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=336 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] The total sum of curved surface area of \(Y\) and \(Z\) \(=135 \pi+336 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(=471 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(>375 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is agreed.

questions.stem:
13. Kelvin has 4 identical solid metal cubes of side 12 cm . From each of the cubes, Kelvin cuts off the largest square pyramid of same shape. All the remaining metals are melted and recast into 27 smaller identical solid square pyramids which are similar to the larger square pyramids cut off from the cubes.

(a) Find the height of a smaller square pyramid.

(b) Find the ratio of the total surface area of a smaller square pyramid to that of a larger square pyramid.

(c) Kelvin claims that the ratio in (b) will be different if the sides of the metal cubes used at the beginning are not 12 cm . Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. Kelvin 有 \(4\) 個邊長 \(12\) cm 的相同實心金屬立方體。從每個立方體切去一個最大的同形正方形底錐體。將所有剩餘金屬熔化後，重鑄成 \(27\) 個與切出的大正方形底錐相似的相同小正方形底錐。

(a) 求小正方形底錐的高。

(b) 求小正方形底錐與大正方形底錐的總表面積之比。

(c) Kelvin 聲稱若最初金屬立方體的邊長不是 \(12\) cm，

(b) 的比便會不同。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of a smaller square pyramid. The largest square pyramid cut from each cube has square base side \(12\) cm and height \(12\) cm. Hence \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3 =4\left(12^3-\frac{1}{3}\cdot 12^2\cdot 12\right).\] Therefore \[9h^3=4608\] and \(h=8\). The height of a smaller square pyramid is \(8\) cm. (b) The ratio of corresponding lengths of a smaller pyramid to a larger pyramid is \(8:12=2:3\). Therefore the ratio of their total surface areas is \[2^2:3^2=4:9.\] (c) I do not agree. If the side of each original cube is \(a\) cm, the largest square pyramid cut off from each cube has volume \(\frac{1}{3}a^3\). The total volume recast is \[4\left(a^3-\frac{1}{3}a^3\right)=\frac{8}{3}a^3.\] If the height of each smaller similar square pyramid is \(h\), then \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3=\frac{8}{3}a^3,\] so \(h=\frac{2a}{3}\). The corresponding length ratio is always \(2:3\), so the surface area ratio is always \(4:9\).

questions.stem:
12. In a workshop, 9 identical solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are melted and recast into a circular cone. It is given that the base radius of the cone is \(18\) cm.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of \(Y\) is \(8:19\). Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 某工作坊將 \(9\) 個半徑 \(6\) cm 的相同實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個圓錐。已知圓錐的底半徑為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積比為 \(8:19\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the circular cone. By conservation of volume, \[\frac13\pi(18)^2h=9\left(\frac43\pi(6)^3\right).\] Hence \[108\pi h=2592\pi,\] so \[ h=24. \] Therefore, the height of the circular cone is \(24\) cm. (b) The volume ratio is \[V_X:V_Y=8:19,\] so \[V_X:V_{\text{whole cone}}=8:27.\] Thus the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \[\sqrt[3]{\frac8{27}}=\frac23.\] The slant height of the whole cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] Hence the radius and slant height of the smaller cone \(X\) are \[12 \text{and} 20\] respectively. Therefore, the curved surface area of the frustum \(Y\) is \[\pi(18+12)(30-20)=300\pi.\]

questions.stem:
13. The slant height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 82 cm and 18 cm respectively. The circular cone is melted and recast into three similar solid right circular cylinders. Denote these three circular cylinders by \(A, B\) and \(C\). It is given that the ratio of the base area of \(A\) to the base area of \(B\) to the base area of \(C\) is \(4: 9: 25\).

(a) Find the volume of \(C\).

(b) There are two solid hemispheres. The radii of the two hemispheres are equal to the base radii of \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. If the sum of the curved surface areas of the two hemispheres is \(234 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\), find the height of \(C\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的斜高及底半徑分別為 \(82\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐熔化後重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓柱，記為 \(A\)、\(B\) 及 \(C\)。已知 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9:25\)。

(a) 求 \(C\) 的體積。

(b) 有兩個實心半球，半徑分別等於 \(A\) 及 \(B\) 的底半徑。若兩個半球的曲面面積和為 \(234\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，求 \(C\) 的高。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the circular cone \[=\sqrt{82^{2}-18^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}\] \[=80 \mathrm{~cm}\] The ratio of the volume of \(A\) to the volume of \(B\) to the volume of \(C\) \[=(\sqrt{4})^{3}:(\sqrt{9})^{3}:(\sqrt{25})^{3}\] \[=(2)^{3}:(3)^{3}:(5)^{3}\] \[=8: 27: 125\] The volume of \(C\) \[=\frac{1}{3} \pi(18)^{2}(80)\left(\frac{125}{8+27+125}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=6750 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(C\). The base radius of \(A\) is \(\frac{2}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\) and the base radius of \(B\) is \(\frac{3}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{2}{5} r\right)^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{3}{5} r\right)^{2} =234 \pi \\ \frac{26}{25} r^{2} =234 \\ r^{2} =225 \\ r =15\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(C\). \(\pi r^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ \pi(15)^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ h =30\) Thus, the height of \(C\) is 30 cm . for the formula of the volume of a cone volume of a cylinder

questions.stem:
14. The base radius of a solid metal right circular cone \(X\) is \(14\) cm. \(X\) is divided into a circular cone \(Y\) and a frustum \(Z\) by a plane parallel to its base. The base radius of \(Y\) is \(10\) cm. \(Z\) is melted and recast into a solid metal hemisphere. The total surface area of the hemisphere is \(432\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express the volume of the hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Does the total surface area of the hemisphere exceed the total surface area of \(Z\)? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 的底半徑為 \(14\) cm。\(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑為 \(10\) cm。將 \(Z\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心金屬半球，半球的總表面積為 \(432\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求半球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 半球的總表面積是否超過 \(Z\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the hemisphere be \(r\) cm. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Given that \[3\pi r^2=432\pi,\] we have \[r^2=144,\] so \[ r=12. \] Therefore, the volume of the hemisphere is \[\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)\] \[=\frac23\pi(12)^3\] \[=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Let the height of cone \(X\) be \(h\) cm. Since cone \(Y\) and cone \(X\) are similar, the height of cone \(Y\) is \[\frac{10}{14}h=\frac57h.\] Thus the volume of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right).\] Since \(Z\) is recast into the hemisphere, \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right)=1152\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{872}{21}h=1152,\] so \[h=\frac{3024}{109}.\] The height of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac27h=\frac{6048}{763}.\] The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{\left(\frac{6048}{763}\right)^2+(14-10)^2}\] \[\approx 8.878686548.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(14^2)+\pi(10^2)+\pi(14+10)(8.878686548).\] Therefore, \[\text{total surface area of }Z\approx 1599.35\text{ cm}^2.\] But \[432\pi\approx 1357.17\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[1357.17<1599.35,\] the total surface area of the hemisphere does not exceed the total surface area of \(Z\). (5 marks)

questions.sourceZh: 來源所列（未獨立核實）：Mock 2526 P1 Q14

questions.stem:
11. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius 5 cm and height 65 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The heights of the smaller cone and the larger cone are 15 cm and 60 cm respectively.

(a) Find the volume of the smaller cone in terms of \(\pi\).
(3 marks)

(b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the larger cone is at least \(2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個底半徑 \(5\) cm、高 \(65\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐及較大圓錐的高分別為 \(15\) cm 及 \(60\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的體積。（3 分）

(b) 某人聲稱較大圓錐的總表面積最少為 \(2000\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius 5 cm and height 65 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The heights of the smaller cone and the larger cone are 15 cm and 60 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the smaller cone in terms of \(\pi\). (b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the larger cone is at least \(2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Volume of the cylinder \[=\pi\left(5^{2}\right)(65) \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathbf{1 M}\] \[=1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Height of the smaller cone : height of the larger cone \[=15 \mathrm{~cm}: 60 \mathrm{~cm}\] \[ =1: 4 \] Volume of the smaller cone \[=\frac{1^{3}}{1^{3}+4^{3}} \times 1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[=25 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the larger cone. \[ \frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2}(60)=1625 \pi-25 \pi \\ r=\sqrt{80}\] Total surface area of the larger cone \( =\left[\pi(\sqrt{80})^{2}+\pi(\sqrt{80}) \sqrt{(\sqrt{80})^{2}+60^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \mathbf{1} \mathbf{M} \text { for } \pi r l+\mathbf{1} \mathbf{A} \\ =(80+80 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ \approx 1955.912856 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. Base radius of the smaller cone \(=\sqrt{\frac{25 \pi \times 3}{\pi(15)}} \mathrm{cm}\) \(=\sqrt{5} \mathrm{~cm}\) Total surface area of the smaller cone \(=\left[\pi(\sqrt{5})^{2}+\pi(\sqrt{5}) \sqrt{(\sqrt{5})^{2}+15^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(\mathbf{1 M}\) for \(\pi r l+\mathbf{1} \mathbf{A}\) \(=(5+5 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) Total surface area of the larger cone \(=[(5+5 \sqrt{46}) \pi \times 16] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=(80+80 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(\approx 1955.912856 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. f.t.

questions.stem:
13. In a workshop, \(2\) identical solid metal right circular cylinders of base radius \(R\) cm are melted and recast into \(27\) smaller identical solid right circular cylinders of base radius \(r\) cm and height \(10\) cm. It is given that the base area of a larger circular cylinder is \(9\) times that of a smaller one.

(a) Find

(i) \(r:R\),
(ii) the height of a larger circular cylinder.

(b) A craftsman claims that a smaller circular cylinder and a larger circular cylinder are similar. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 某工作坊將 \(2\) 個底半徑 \(R\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成 \(27\) 個底半徑 \(r\) cm、高 \(10\) cm 的較小相同實心直立圓柱。已知較大圓柱的底面積為較小圓柱的 \(9\) 倍。

(a) 求

(i) \(r:R\)；
(ii) 較大圓柱的高。

(b) 某工匠聲稱較小圓柱與較大圓柱相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a)(i) \(\frac{\pi r^2}{\pi R^2}=\frac19.\) Thus \(\frac{r}{R}=\frac13,\) so \(r:R=1:3.\) (a)(ii) Let the height of a larger cylinder be \(h\) cm. By conservation of volume, \(2\pi R^2h=27(\pi r^2)(10).\) Thus \(h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^2 =135\left(\frac13\right)^2=15.\) (b) The radius ratio smaller:larger is \(1:3\), but the height ratio smaller:larger is \[10:15=2:3.\] The ratios are not equal, so the cylinders are not similar. The claim is disagreed. Final answers: (a)(i) \(1:3\); (a)(ii) \(15\) cm; (b) disagree.

questions.stem:
14. The base radius of the solid right circular cylinder \(X\) and the base radius of the solid right circular cone \(Y\) are equal. The heights of \(X\) and \(Y\) are \(20\text{ cm}\) and \(24\text{ cm}\) respectively. The volume of the solid right circular cone \(Z\) is equal to the sum of the volume of \(X\) and the volume of \(Y\). The base radius of \(Z\) is equal to the base diameter of \(X\). A craftsman finds that the volume of \(Y\) is \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(a) Find the base radius of \(Y\).

(b) Are \(Y\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.

(c) The craftsman claims that the sum of the curved surface area of \(X\) and the curved surface area of \(Y\) is greater than the curved surface area of \(Z\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 實心直立圓柱 \(X\) 的底半徑與實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 的底半徑相等。\(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。實心直立圓錐 \(Z\) 的體積等於 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積之和，\(Z\) 的底半徑等於 \(X\) 的底直徑。某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的體積為 \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的底半徑。

(b) \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

(c) 該工匠聲稱 \(X\) 的曲面面積與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積之和大於 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Let the common base radius of \(X\) and \(Y\) be \(r\). \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=800\pi\] so \[8r^2=800,\qquad r=10.\] (b) The base radius of \(Z\) is \(20\). The volume of \(X\) is \[\pi(10)^2(20)=2000\pi.\] Thus the volume of \(Z\) is \(2800\pi\). Since the radius ratio \(Y:Z=10:20=1:2\) but the volume ratio \(800\pi:2800\pi=2:7\ne 1:8\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not similar. (c) The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[2\pi(10)(20)=400\pi.\] The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26\), so the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi(10)(26)=260\pi.\] For \(Z\), \[\frac13\pi(20)^2h=2800\pi\] so \(h=21\), and its slant height is \(\sqrt{20^2+21^2}=29\). Hence the curved surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20)(29)=580\pi.\] Since \[400\pi+260\pi=660\pi>580\pi,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(10\text{ cm}\); (b) no; (c) agree.

questions.stem:
13. The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side 64 cm. The height of the pyramid is 24 cm. The pyramid is divided into a frustum \(X\) and a pyramid \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(Y\) is 18 cm.

(a) Find the volume of \(X\).

(b) The base of another solid right pyramid is a square. This pyramid is divided into a frustum \(Z\) and a pyramid by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the total surface area of \(Z\) are 3 cm and \(960\text{ cm}^2\) respectively. Are \(X\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(64\) cm 的正方形，錐體高 \(24\) cm。該錐體被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(X\) 及一個錐體 \(Y\)。已知 \(Y\) 的高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立錐體的底面為正方形，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(Z\) 及一個錐體。\(Z\) 的高及總表面積分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(960\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(64^2)(24).\] The small pyramid \(Y\) has linear scale factor \[\frac{18}{24}=\frac34.\] Hence \[\text{Volume of }X=\frac13(64^2)(24)\left(1-\left(\frac34\right)^3\right)=18944\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The total surface area of \(X\) is \[8640\text{ cm}^2.\] If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, their height ratio would be \[6:3=2:1,\] so their surface area ratio should be \[ 4:1. \] However, \[\frac{8640}{960}=9.\] Since \(9\ne4\), \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar. Final answers: (a) \(18944\text{ cm}^3\); (b) not similar.

questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are \(20\) cm and \(48\) cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a frustum \(P\), a frustum \(Q\) and a circular cone \(R\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and the height of \(P\) is \(12\) cm.

(a) Find the volume of \(P\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a circular cone \(T\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is \(16\) cm. The total surface area of \(S\) is the same as the sum of the total surface areas of \(P\) and \(Q\). Are \(P\) and \(S\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\)、一個截頭錐 \(Q\) 及一個圓錐 \(R\)。已知 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 相似，\(P\) 的高為 \(12\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 的總表面積之和。\(P\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: (a) The radius of the upper circular face of \(P\) is \[20\cdot\frac{48-12}{48}=15.\] Hence \[V_P =\frac13\pi(20)^2(48)-\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)\\ =\boxed{3700\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{20^2+48^2}=52.\] The slant height of \(P\) is \[52\cdot\frac{12}{48}=13.\] Thus the total surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi.\] Since \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and their linear ratio is \(20:15=4:3\), \[\text{TSA of }Q=1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Therefore \[\text{TSA of }S=1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }P}=\frac{1687.5}{1080}=\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }P}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2=\frac{16}{9}.\] Since these are not equal, \(P\) and \(S\) are not similar.

questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 64 cm and 48 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a frustum \(X\) and a circular cone \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(Y\) is 18 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of \(X\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(Z\) and a circular cone by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the total surface area of \(Z\) are 10 cm and \(1296 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) respectively. Are \(X\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(64\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(X\) 及一個圓錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(Y\) 的高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(Z\) 及一個圓錐。\(Z\) 的高及總表面積分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(1296\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The original cone has radius \(64\) cm and height \(48\) cm. The smaller cone removed from the top has height \(18\) cm, so its linear scale factor is \(\frac{18}{48}\). (a) \[V_X =\frac13\pi(64)^2(48)\left[1-\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^3\right]\\ =\boxed{62080\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{48^2+64^2}=80\text{ cm}.\] Thus, the curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(64)(80)\left[1-\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^2\right]=4400\pi.\] Including the two circular ends, \[\text{total surface area} =4400\pi+\pi(64)^2\left[1+\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^2\right]\\ =\boxed{9072\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\]

questions.sourceZh: 來源所列（未獨立核實）：Extra 2425 P1 Q13

questions.stem:
11. The base radius of a solid right circular cone \(X\) is three times its height. The radius of a solid metal sphere \(Y\) is the same as the base radius of \(X\). It is given that the sum of the volumes of \(X\) and \(Y\) is \(4875\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(a) Find the base radius of \(X\).

(b) The sphere \(Y\) is then melted and recast into a right circular cone \(Z\) of curved surface area \(3000\text{ cm}^2\). Are \(X\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\) 的底半徑為其高的三倍。一個實心金屬球 \(Y\) 的半徑與 \(X\) 的底半徑相同。已知 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積和為 \(4875\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。

(b) 將球 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成一個曲面面積 \(3000\text{ cm}^2\) 的直立圓錐 \(Z\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius of \(X\) be \(r\) cm. Then the height of \(X\) is \(\frac r3\). Hence \[\frac13\pi r^2\left(\frac r3\right)+\frac43\pi r^3=4875\pi.\] So \[\frac{13}{9}r^3=4875,\qquad r^3=3375,\qquad r=\boxed{15}.\] (b) The volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(15)^2(5)=375\pi.\] The volume of \(Z\) is equal to the volume of \(Y\), which is \[\frac43\pi(15)^3=4500\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_Z}{V_X}=12.\] If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, their curved surface area ratio would be \[12^{2/3}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{15^2+5^2}=75\pi\sqrt{10}.\] But \[\frac{3000}{75\pi\sqrt{10}}\ne 12^{2/3}.\] Therefore, \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）X 高 r/3：
\[
\frac13\pi r^2\left(\frac r3\right)+\frac43\pi r^3=4875\pi,\quad r=15.
\]
（b）X = 375π，Z = 4500π。V_Z/V_X = 12。

questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a frustum \(P\) and a right circular cone \(Q\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(P\) is 16 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(75\) cm 及 \(40\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的高為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: (a) The height of cone \(Q\) is \(40-16=24\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r_Q}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \(r_Q=45\) cm. The slant heights of the original cone and \(Q\) are \(85\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. Hence the curved surface area of \(P\) is \(\pi(75)(85)-\pi(45)(51)=4080\pi.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(P\) is \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=\boxed{11730\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)=58800\pi.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) were similar, then \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}.\] However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8.\] Since \(8\ne\frac{4096}{343}\), \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of \(Q\) is \[40-16=24\text{ cm}.\] Let the base radius of \(Q\) be \(r\text{ cm}\). By similarity, \[\frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40}.\] Thus \[ r=45. \] The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{75^2+40^2}=85\text{ cm},\] and the slant height of \(Q\) is \[\sqrt{45^2+24^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] Hence the slant height of \(P\) is \[85-51=34\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Therefore the total surface area of \(P\) is \[4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (4 marks) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24)=58800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) are similar, the ratio of their volumes should be the cube of the ratio of their corresponding lengths. Now \[\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343},\] but \[\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8.\] Since \[\frac{4096}{343}\ne 8,\] \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar. (3 marks)

questions.solution: 12. Let the distance from the vertex of the cone to the two cutting planes be \(a\) cm and \(36\) cm respectively. Since the height of \(P\) is 12 cm, the upper cutting plane of \(P\) is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex. The radii at distances \(a\), \(36\) and \(48\) cm from the vertex are proportional to these distances. Since \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar, \[\frac{a}{36}=\frac{36}{48}.\] Hence \[ a=27. \] Therefore, the height of \(Q\) is \[36-27=9\text{ cm}.\] The radii at distances \(36\) cm and \(48\) cm from the vertex are \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}\] and \[20\text{ cm}\] respectively. (a) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) For \(P\), the slant height is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] Thus the total surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] For \(Q\), the radii are \[20\left(\frac{27}{48}\right)=11.25\] and \[ 15. \] Its slant height is \[\sqrt{9^2+(15-11.25)^2}=9.75.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Q\) is \[\pi(15+11.25)(9.75)+\pi(15)^2+\pi(11.25)^2\] \[=607.5\pi.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] If \(P\) and \(S\) are similar, since their heights are 12 cm and 16 cm respectively, the surface area of \(S\) should be \[1080\pi\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =1920\pi.\] However, \[1687.5\pi\ne 1920\pi.\] Therefore, \(P\) and \(S\) are not similar. (3 marks)

(b) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 及 \(Z\)。\(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的底面積比為 \(16:25\)。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 量得 \(Z\) 的總表面積為 \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the base radius of \(X\). Since the curved surface area is \(\pi r l\), \[\pi r(85)=3060\pi.\] Thus \[ r=36. \] The height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{85^2-36^2}=77.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(77)=33264\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Since the base area ratio of \(Y\) to \(Z\) is \(16:25\), their linear ratio is \(4:5\). Hence \(\frac{\text{volume of }Y}{\text{volume of }Z}=\left(\frac45\right)^3=\frac{64}{125}.\) Let the volume of \(Z\) be \(V\). Then the volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac{64}{125}V\), so \(V+\frac{64}{125}V=33264\pi.\) Thus \(\frac{189}{125}V=33264\pi,\) and \(V=22000\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(Z\) is \(22000\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b)(ii) If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, then \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\left(\frac{\text{total surface area of }X}{\text{total surface area of }Z}\right)^{3/2}.\) The total surface area of \(X\) is \(3060\pi+\pi(36)^2=4356\pi.\) Now \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\frac{33264}{22000}=\frac{189}{125},\) but \(\left(\frac{4356\pi}{3025\pi}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac{36}{25}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac65\right)^3 =\frac{216}{125}.\) These are not equal. Therefore, \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar.

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer. (a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Q\). Height of \(Q=(40-16) \mathrm{cm}=24 \mathrm{~cm}\) \(\frac{\text { Base radius of } Q}{\text { Base radius of the original circular cone }}=\frac{\text { height of } Q}{\text { height of the original circular cone }}\) \(\frac{r}{75} =\frac{24}{40} \\ r =45\) Curved surface area of \(P\) \[=\left[\pi(75) \sqrt{40^{2}+75^{2}}-\pi(45) \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=4080 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Total surface area of \(P\) \[=\left[4080 \pi+\pi(45)^{2}+\pi(75)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=11730 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] (b) Volume of \(P\) \[=\left[\frac{1}{3} \pi(75)^{2}(40)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(45)^{2}(24)\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=58800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[\left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^{3}=\frac{4096}{343}\] \[\frac{\text { Volume of } P}{\text { Volume of } R}=\frac{58800 \pi}{7350 \pi}=8\] \[\because \left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3} \neq \frac{\text { volume of } P}{\text { volume of } R}\] \(\therefore P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of cone \(Q\) is \[40-16=24\text{ cm}.\] Let the base radius of \(Q\) be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \[ r=45. \] The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{75^2+40^2}=85.\] The slant height of cone \(Q\) is \[\sqrt{45^2+24^2}=51.\] Therefore, the slant height of frustum \(P\) is \[85-51=34.\] The curved surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(P\) is \[4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2\] \[=4080\pi+5625\pi+2025\pi =11730\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (4 marks) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)\] \[=75000\pi-16200\pi =58800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) are similar, then the ratio of their volumes should be the cube of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8,\] while \[\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}\ne 8.\] Therefore, \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar. (3 marks)
